**Job Description:**

**About the Team**

Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product, and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting\-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers, and users. From revolutionizing data visualization to optimizing analytical tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video, and social platforms, our team is committed to providing seamless, data\-driven insights across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking analytical products and data technologies.


**About the Role**

As an Analytics Manager, you will report into the Sr Analytics Director and lead a team of analysts supporting high\-impact B2C initiatives across the Dow Jones portfolio. Focused on people management and team leadership, this role requires a strong analytical foundation to support analysts and guide complex work. You will set priorities, develop talent, ensure strong execution, and lead a high\-performing team delivering clear, reliable, actionable insights to Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Data partners.


A primary focus of this role will be coaching and growing analysts, shaping team processes, and ensuring the team is aligned to the most important business opportunities. You will help define analytical standards, guide the team through ambiguity, and partner with stakeholders to ensure work is well scoped, high quality, and tied to business impact. Success in this role will come from strong people leadership combined with a deep analytical background, sound judgment, and the ability to extend the team’s impact through hands\-on guidance and scalable management.


**You Will:**

* Lead and Manage a Team of Analysts: Directly manage, coach, and develop a team of analysts, providing regular feedback and growth opportunities that support individual development and team success.
* Set Priorities and Drive Team Execution: Translate business goals into a clear team roadmap, allocate resources across competing requests, and ensure the team is focused on the highest\-impact work.
* Develop Talent and Build Team Capability: Foster a strong culture of learning and accountability by mentoring analysts, supporting career development, and helping the team continue to grow in scope and impact.
* Partner Cross\-Functionally: Serve as the primary analytics partner for key stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Data, ensuring strong alignment, clear communication, and effective delivery.
* Champion AI\-Enabled Analytics: Encourage thoughtful use of AI tools to improve team productivity, analytical workflows, and the speed and quality of insight generation, while maintaining strong analytical standards and judgment.
* Ensure High\-Quality Insight Delivery: Provide analytical guidance and oversight on analyses, reporting, and experimentation so the team delivers accurate, actionable, and decision\-ready insights.
* Navigate Complexity and Remove Roadblocks: Help the team solve ambiguous business problems, apply strong analytical judgment to complex questions, manage stakeholder expectations, and unblock work in a fast\-paced environment.

**You Have:**

* 6\+ years in data analytics, business analytics, or data science, including meaningful experience managing, coaching, or developing analysts.
* Demonstrated success leading teams, setting priorities, and driving execution across multiple high\-impact workstreams, while maintaining high analytical standards.
* Strong people management skills, with experience giving feedback, supporting performance, and helping individuals grow in scope and capability.
* Strong experience applying analytics to digital subscription products, customer lifecycle measurement, engagement analysis, and high\-traffic digital experiences, with the ability to coach others through complex analytical problems.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and strong working knowledge of Python or R for large\-scale data analysis and statistical interpretation.
* Expertise in data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms, with the ability to help teams communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience partnering cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams to influence prioritization and business outcomes.
* Experience using AI tools such as Copilot, Claude Code, or OpenAI products to improve productivity and analytical workflows is a plus.
* A BS in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Our Benefits:**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Plans for you and your family (paid by Dow Jones)
* Extra paid Time Off (30 days of holidays/year)
* Possibility to work remotely for 3 months/year (desplazamiento program) or one week of remote work per quarter
* Meal benefit with Pluxee (171€/month on top of your salary)
* Retirement Plans (Dow Jones will pay 2% of a members Pensionable Salary and match employee contribution up to a maximum of 3 %).
* Comprehensive Insurance Plans
* Well\-being Resources (200 USD allowance per quarter, Classpass, etc.)
* Family Care Benefits \& Caregiving Support

title: Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for two talented Operations Specialist to lead the operations of a wide range of clients. You are expected to perform a transversal role, translating new customers’ needs into technical specifications, planning and delivering excellent services.

* Delivering excellent services and results to clients, both internally and externally.
* Implement and run Quality Assurance processes for every delivery.
* Understanding clients’ needs and finding optimal solutions.
* Discerning the technical capabilities of the tools and the team and translating them to clients.
* Transforming clients’ challenges into opportunities for growth.
* Creating better internal processes and leading changes.
* Developing creative solutions for existing and new clients.

  

**Requirements** **All About You**

* Basic understanding of the music industry, including familiarity with key standards and organizations (e.g., CISAC, CMOs, etc.)
* \+3 years experience in technical account management, project coordination, or client\-support roles, preferably in technical or fast\-paced environments.
* Ability to effectively communicate with team members, stakeholders, and external partners.
* Highly organized, multitasker, and with strong attention to detail.
* Initiative, drive, enthusiasm, and entrepreneurial attitude.
* Excellent decision\-making, critical thinking, and problem\-solving.
* Passion for listening, asking, understanding, and communicating.
* Love for teamwork and learning.
* Be comfortable dealing with a large amount of data and numbers in formats such as .csv and .xlsx
* Interest or basic familiarity with MongoDB and ability to use queries for data retrieval and manipulation.
* Business fluency in English is a must
* Language Specialization (One of the following):
* + Profile A: Professional working proficiency in French.
	+ Profile B: Professional working proficiency in Italian.

Based in Spain. Local candidates are preferred, but remote work arrangements may be considered.  
* 

**Expectations**

* Within 30 days:  

To understand the services and products your team is working on, the basic operations behind them and their technical pipelines.
* Within 60 days  

Assuming your assigned operational responsibilities, support our UGC Business Line and manage a straightforward delivery for a customer following the step\-by\-step preexisting guide.
* Within 90 days  

Become an active contributor within the team, capable of improving our operational process based on previous experiences.

  

**Benefits** **You Can Enjoy**

* Flexible working hours and location
* Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest.
* You can make the role your own and run your own development
* Flat hierarchy
* Online language classes to improve your Spanish or English
* Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts
* We’ll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable
* Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room https://www.bmat.com/bmat\-house/

**Who the FAQ are BMAT**


BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin\-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We’re now over 200 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, Nairobi, Oslo, Tel\-Aviv, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos.


We’re a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We’re open\-minded and well\-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We’ve got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music, the excitement for innovative technology and Barcelona as a backdrop has proven to make a good combination.


Join us from wherever you are on our mission to help make music live forever.

*Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open\-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open\-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time\-zones \- but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work.*

title: Store Manager Brussels
description:
We are a family\-run business with more than 145 years of experience in footwear production and design. Throughout our history we have always been innovators, sustainably growing our business to create what we have today, including over 200 stores and presence in more than 100 countries.


Our mission? Walking with purpose, delighting people with a playful, sustainable and responsible walking experience.

**About the Role**


We are currently looking for a Store Manager to lead our Camper store in **Brussels \- Galerie du roi** ; an individual who is passionate, proactive, and aligned with our brand values: REAL, IMAGINATIVE, PLAYFUL and CARING.


As a Camper **Store Manager**, your mission will be to attain the objectives in terms of sales, service and business growth.


We’re counting on you to offer the full brand experience to our omnichannel consumers, develop the team’s potential and oversee all the operations of the store in order to achieve the best level of customer service and business efficiency.


Your main tasks will be:

* Customer Experience Management: Our customers matter! You will have a crucial role in ensuring that the level of customer satisfaction is met by providing an outstanding service and developing long\-term relationships with our customers at an omnichannel level.
* Team Management: our people are the key asset at Camper! You will be taking on the role of leader within the team, actively participating in the recruitment process, acting as a trainer/coach and always inspiring and leading by example
* Business Results \& Efficiency: Optimizing is our ultimate goal. As a Store Manager you are required to manage the point of sale efficiently, influencing commercial decisions and taking business analysis into account.
* Brand image: Each store embodies the Company’s culture, values and principles. You will be responsible for Camper brand image towards our customers, with the aim of ensuring a premium image aligned with the Company’s identity and ESG principals.
* Operational excellence: In the omnichannel era, operations are key and have a great impact on the connection chain with the customer. You will carry out store operations according to the Company’s Policies \& Procedures. Organization leads to efficiency.

**About You**


You are our perfect match if:

* You are passionate about Retail, in all of its shades (in\-store and omnichannel).
* You have minimum 2 years of experience leading a team.
* You are flexible and available to work full\-time.
* You inspire people and have a strong team spirit and great energy.
* You are a great communicator and decision\-maker and are highly results\-oriented.
* You encourage and promote curiosity, diversity and collaboration through your innovative mindset.
* You can speak fluent French and English. Dutch proficiency will be a plus.
* You have the legal right to work in European Union without requiring visa sponsorship.


If you feel we’re talking about you and want to join our big Camper family, click and apply.


We look forward to receiving your application!


Want to learn more about us? Visit our LinkedIn page or Camper.com to start walking with us today!

* Champion local market needs and ensure they are reflected in campaign strategy and execution.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Sales, and other business functions.

* Lead end\-to\-end campaign management, from briefing and planning through execution, optimization, and post\-campaign analysis.

* Monitor market performance against targets.
* Proactively identify risks and opportunities, recommending actions to improve performance.
* Maintain visibility into the drivers of market performance and communicate insights to stakeholders.

* Maintain a holistic view of all Consumer Marketing channels, including Paid, CRM, Social, and Editorial.
* Work closely with channel owners to ensure execution supports market objectives.
* Ensure consistency in messaging and customer experience across all touchpoints.

* Contribute to annual, quarterly, and campaign planning for the Italian market.
* Support forecasting processes and ensure plans are realistic and aligned with business goals.
* Help prioritize initiatives based on expected impact and available resources.

### **Reporting \& Insights**


* Deliver regular reporting on campaign and market performance.
* Share key learnings, insights, and recommendations with relevant stakeholders.
* Use data\-driven insights to inform future marketing strategies and campaign improvements.

* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
* Continuously develop marketing expertise and stay up to date with industry trends and best practices.
* Seek feedback and contribute positively to team culture and collaboration.

title: Senior Direct Response Funnel Copywriter & Strategist
description:
About Us


HarZa Group is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves more than 400,000 customers with products targeting chronic pain and mobility, including RejuvaKnee, FootRenew, RejuvaFlow and OzemPatch. We ship primarily to the United States and run a membership program that powers recurring revenue. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.


The Role


We are looking for an exceptional senior direct response copywriter to take ownership of our post\-click funnels. This is not a role for someone who receives a brief, writes the copy and moves on. We are looking for someone who treats funnels the way an exceptional creative strategist treats advertising: research the customer and the market, form a hypothesis, develop the concept, write the copy, get the funnel launched, study the performance, identify the constraint, develop the next test, and turn every result into a feedback loop.


You will be deeply involved in the commercial performance of everything you write. Once a funnel goes live you should be watching click\-through rates, advertorial to sales page click\-through, quiz completion, sales page and checkout conversion, revenue per visitor, average order value, order bump and upsell take rates, refund rates and contribution margin. A page is not finished when the copy is approved. It is finished when it has launched, been measured, and produced a learning that improves the next page.


Your ultimate objective is to remove the founders from writing and reviewing routine funnel copy. Initially they will remain closely involved and may still write a large share of it. You will work directly with them, learn their frameworks, understand their decision\-making, and gradually take ownership of the function. Success means reaching the point where the founders no longer need to write funnel copy, rewrite your work, or independently double\-check it before launch. From there you create leverage through AI systems, documented processes and, in time, additional writers trained and managed beneath you.


A Note on the Category


This is claims\-led direct response, not product\-led ecommerce, and the distinction matters more than any other line in this description. Our products address chronic pain and mobility. The benefit is not visually obvious, it cannot be demonstrated in a photograph, and it cannot be sold on aspiration. Belief has to be built through mechanism, proof, advertorial and presell structure, and honest handling of objections, all inside the compliance limits of a health category.


Copywriters who have scaled fashion, accessories, beauty or other visually self\-evident products often find that their playbook does not transfer. A strong track record in a product\-led category is welcome but does not substitute for this. We will prioritize candidates who have written for health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category and who understand what can and cannot be said.


Why This Role Is Different


The founders have generated more than nine figures in post\-purchase upsell revenue in under twenty\-four months. That figure is post\-purchase upsell revenue specifically, not total front\-end company revenue. You will get direct access to the frameworks behind those results, existing research, templates, processes and funnel data, direct feedback and training from the founders, a portfolio of brands and offers with significant traffic, a high\-volume testing environment where your ideas get launched and measured, and real commercial data across multiple funnel types, offers and traffic sources.


This is an opportunity to develop beyond being a copywriter. The right person can progress toward Head of Funnel Copy, Head of Funnel Strategy, Director of Conversion, or operator of one of our portfolio brands. We prefer to promote from within, and progression is based on commercial results, leadership ability and the amount of responsibility you can absorb.

 **Requirements**  

What You Will Own


Post\-Click Funnel Strategy


Act as the strategic owner of post\-click messaging and conversion copy. Participate in marketing, campaign and offer planning, understand what each traffic source needs after the click, and ensure message continuity between the advertisement, presell page, sales page, checkout and upsell journey. Recommend the right funnel format based on the offer, traffic source, customer awareness and market sophistication, and determine when a campaign needs an advertorial, listicle, quiz, long\-form page, short\-form page or another structure. Collaborate with media buyers and creative strategists to understand the promise that generated the click, and identify disconnects between the ad message and the landing page experience. Your remit begins at the click, but you must understand the whole acquisition system to make intelligent post\-click decisions.


Customer and Market Research


Research the customer before developing the copy. Analyze reviews, surveys, support tickets, customer interviews, call transcripts, refund reasons and community discussions. Study competitor offers, positioning, mechanisms, pricing and funnel structures. Identify desires, fears, frustrations, failed solutions, objections and buying triggers, understand the customer's level of awareness and the sophistication of the market, and distinguish between what customers say they want and what their behaviour suggests they value. Build voice\-of\-customer libraries that preserve the language customers actually use, validate that claims are supportable and appropriate for the category, and convert raw research into usable copy insight rather than research documents nobody reads.


Hypothesis Before Writing


Every meaningful funnel project begins with a clear hypothesis. Identify the metric or funnel stage being targeted, diagnose the likely reason for underperformance, state the customer insight behind the diagnosis, define what will change and why it should influence behaviour, select a primary success metric and the guardrails around it, and determine what result would validate or invalidate the idea. The first question is not what copy should I write. It is what is the constraint, why does it exist, and what evidence suggests this is the right solution.


Writing Complete Funnels


Write and optimize new offer positioning, unique mechanisms, big ideas, hooks and leads, advertorials, listicles, quiz flows, long\-form and short\-form sales pages, product detail pages, offer sections, pricing and bundle presentation, guarantees, checkout copy, order bumps, post\-purchase upsells, downsells, cross\-sells, funnel transitions, calls to action, and the supporting briefs for page graphics and visual proof. You must be able to develop a major long\-form funnel from a blank page and equally to identify and rewrite the one critical section inside an existing funnel.


The Offer, Not Only the Words


Copy cannot be separated from the offer. You will think critically about positioning, price, quantity, bundles, discounts, bonuses, guarantees, payment options, shipping thresholds, subscription structures, order bumps, upsell sequencing and offer continuity through the funnel. You should be willing to conclude that the copy is not the main problem and that the right recommendation is to change the offer, reorder the upsells, change the price, improve the guarantee, remove a step or target a different segment. Your responsibility is to improve the commercial result, not to defend the original brief.


Funnel Economics


Understand the underlying economics of each offer, including selling price, cost of goods, pick and pack, shipping, payment processing, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, subscription take rates, upsell margins, gross and contribution margin, customer acquisition cost, and revenue and profit per visitor. A higher AOV is not automatically better if contribution margin falls, a higher conversion rate is not better if refunds rise, and a pricing test must be judged on full funnel economics rather than one isolated metric. You do not need to be a finance professional. You do need to think like an owner.


Staying Close to Live Performance


Once your copy is launched, confirm the correct version went live, review performance against the control and at each funnel step, segment where appropriate, compare mobile and desktop, look for discrepancies between traffic sources, use heatmaps and behavioural data where helpful, and compare primary against guardrail metrics. Document what worked, what did not and why, recommend the next action, and feed every meaningful learning back into research and writing. You should feel personal ownership of the result without becoming defensive when an idea loses. A losing test that produces a real learning is useful. A test launched without a hypothesis and never reviewed is not.


The Learning System and AI Leverage


Build and maintain a searchable archive of tests and results recording the original problem, hypothesis, change, result and learning. Identify recurring patterns across brands and funnel types, separate genuine principles from conclusions drawn on insufficient data, convert repeated winners into reusable frameworks, and prevent failed concepts from being unknowingly repeated. Insight should become company knowledge rather than living in one person's head.


Alongside that, become highly AI\-enabled. Use and improve AI\-assisted systems for research synthesis, voice\-of\-customer clustering, transcript and review analysis, competitor and mechanism research, angle development, hypothesis generation, copy outlining, first drafts, variations, objection identification, quality control, claim consistency review, funnel analysis and test documentation. You will not use a generic chatbot to produce first drafts. You will help build structured processes containing the right context, approved source material, brand knowledge, customer research, historical winners, founder frameworks, defined quality criteria and clear review stages. The standard is not whether AI was used. It is whether AI helped us produce better research, better copy, more tests and faster learning without lowering quality.


What We Are Looking For


Substantial professional experience in direct response copywriting, gained over several years writing for real offers with meaningful traffic. A portfolio containing both long\-form and short\-form funnel copy, significant experience writing for cold traffic, and proven experience in DTC ecommerce, direct response or another measurable\-response environment. Evidence that your work has generated meaningful revenue or measurable conversion improvement. Experience writing complete funnels rather than isolated page sections, including advertorials, listicles, sales pages, quizzes, checkouts and post\-purchase upsells.


Experience in health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category, and an understanding of how to build belief where the benefit is not visually demonstrable. A strong grasp of customer awareness, market sophistication, offers, mechanisms, leads, proof, objections and risk reversal. The ability to conduct and synthesize deep customer research and turn it into a clear hypothesis and a persuasive argument.


Strong analytical fluency and comfort with funnel performance data, the ability to diagnose where a funnel is losing customers, a working understanding of AOV, revenue per visitor, upsell take rates, gross margin and contribution margin, experience creating and evaluating conversion tests, and the ability to distinguish correlation, noise and meaningful evidence.


Strong AI fluency with evidence of using AI inside a real research, writing or analysis workflow. The ability to write quickly without sacrificing strategic depth, the confidence to challenge a weak brief or assumption, the humility to change direction when the data disproves an idea, the communication skills to work with founders, media buyers, designers and analysts, and the potential to train and lead additional writers as the function grows. You must be able to overlap consistently with our collaboration window of 8:00am to 12:00pm EST.


High\-volume Meta, native, Google or affiliate traffic, post\-purchase upsell funnels, portfolio or multi\-brand environments, CRO or direct response agencies, subscription offers, and experience building copy systems or training programs are all highly advantageous.


Evidence We Expect to See


Applicants should demonstrate results, not simply submit polished writing samples. Strong evidence includes funnel revenue, conversion rate improvements, revenue per visitor and AOV improvements, upsell take rate and contribution margin improvements, results against an established control, evidence of scaling an offer, before and after funnel performance, and a sequence of tests showing how an insight developed over time.


We understand that candidates may be under confidentiality agreements. Results can be anonymized, but you should still be able to explain what the offer was, what the original problem was, what you personally owned, what research you conducted, what hypothesis you formed, what you changed, which metric moved, how much traffic supported the conclusion, and what happened next. We are more interested in clear thinking and honest attribution than impressive numbers without context.


This Role Is Not


This is not a junior copywriting position, a brand copy role, a content or social media role, or an ad\-copy\-only position. It is not a role where you write from a brief without questioning it, where your responsibility ends when the document is submitted, or where you would rather your work was not measured. It is not a pure CRO analyst role in which you never write, nor a management\-only role in which you no longer produce. It is not for someone who uses AI to generate generic copy and calls that leverage, who needs the founders to supply every angle and mechanism, who waits to be told which test to run, or who blames media buying, design or development without investigating the full funnel.

 **Benefits**  

What We Offer


A fully remote senior position with genuine ownership of a function that directly determines how fast the business can move. We offer paid time off, a monthly wellness stipend, medical insurance support, a company\-funded computer allowance after a tenure milestone, a birthday gift card, an in\-country meetup allowance, and participation in company\-funded leadership offsites. You will have direct access to the founders, a high\-volume testing environment, and the mandate to build the system rather than inherit someone else's process.

title: Head of Web Production (DTC Growth Technology)
description:
About Us


HarZa Group is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves more than 400,000 customers with products targeting chronic pain and mobility, including RejuvaKnee, FootRenew, RejuvaFlow and OzemPatch. We ship primarily to the United States and run a membership program that powers recurring revenue. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.


The Role


We are a direct\-to\-consumer business where technology is a direct function of marketing. Our marketing team can develop a campaign idea and write the copy for it in a single day, but that idea only starts producing revenue once it has become a live, accurate and fully functioning landing page, checkout or funnel. The speed of our production function therefore sets the speed of the entire business.


We are hiring a Head of Web Production to build and own the operating system through which marketing requirements become live digital experiences. Your responsibility is not to manage tasks, chase deadlines or add project management meetings. It is to redesign how the work gets done. You will examine every stage of production, remove unnecessary handoffs, improve requirements, manage dependencies, install effective quality controls, and decide where AI, automation, page builders, reusable components or traditional development should be used.


For every requirement you should be asking whether this genuinely needs a developer, whether it can be built from an existing component or template, whether an AI\-enabled page builder can complete most of it, whether the marketing team can safely complete it without engineering, whether the requirement can be eliminated or standardized, whether the quality check can be automated, and why it is taking as long as it is. Your job is to protect the business objective while continuously challenging the method used to achieve it.


To be explicit about scope, this is not a cloud infrastructure or site reliability role. This is web production and development operations for a high\-volume direct response marketing business.

 **Requirements**  

What You Will Own


The Production Operating System


Map and redesign the workflow from marketing request to production launch, identifying bottlenecks, unnecessary handoffs, waiting time and duplicated work, and establishing clear ownership at every stage. Define what information must exist before work can begin, create work\-in\-progress limits and prioritization rules, and build separate production lanes for urgent changes, standard pages, experiments and complex technical projects so that urgent work stops destroying the predictability of planned work. Create clear escalation paths for blockers and for requirements that change mid\-build.


Requirements and Task Definition


Build standardized briefs for landing pages, checkouts, funnels, upsells and technical changes, and establish a Definition of Ready for every category of work so that incomplete or ambiguous requests never enter development. Ensure every requirement carries complete copy, design direction, references, responsive behaviour, tracking requirements and acceptance criteria, and translate marketing intent into specifications that developers and page builders can execute without repeated clarification. Create a controlled process for requirements that change after development has begun.


AI\-First Production


Audit the full production process for opportunities to use AI and automation, evaluate AI coding tools, AI page builders, no\-code platforms, reusable components and template\-based systems, and determine the right balance between developers, page builders, designers and AI\-enabled operators. Build workflows where AI converts approved briefs, copy and designs into high\-quality first drafts, install guardrails that allow non\-developers to build safely without damaging performance, tracking or brand standards, and reduce repetitive development through reusable sections and approved design systems. Measure the actual impact of AI on cycle time, cost, quality and throughput rather than assuming it.


Dependencies and Capacity


Create visibility over the workload and capacity of development, design and other shared resources, identify dependencies before work enters production, and sequence work based on when copy, graphics, video, development and approvals will realistically be available. Prevent developers from being assigned work that cannot be completed because a dependency is missing, build a capacity planning system that lets marketing understand what can actually be delivered and when, and surface constraints early enough for the business to reprioritize or find an alternative. Reduce reliance on informal messages and on individual managers holding critical information in their heads.


Quality Built Into the Process


Move quality control upstream instead of relying on final\-stage inspection. Introduce developer self\-QC before any task is submitted, create standardized QC checklists by page and funnel type, define acceptance criteria before development begins, and establish an independent final QC process that does not depend entirely on one person. Implement automated testing wherever practical, including visual regression, broken links, responsive layouts, tracking, checkout functionality, browser compatibility and page performance. Categorize defects, track root causes, and ensure repeated defects change the underlying system, checklist, component or training rather than being corrected one at a time.


Team Structure and Capability


Lead the existing production team and raise its operating standard. Determine which work should be completed by developers and which should be completed by AI\-enabled production specialists, and make sure capability is matched to the work. Coach the team on estimation, task clarification, self\-QC and AI\-assisted workflows, set clear performance expectations for speed, predictability and quality, and build enough documentation and shared visibility that the function does not depend on any single person holding critical context.


The Measurement System


Build and maintain reporting on request\-to\-launch cycle time, active production time versus waiting time, throughput by work category, on\-time delivery, clarification interactions after assignment, first\-pass QC rate, average revision rounds, escaped defect rate, rework hours, blocker age, the share of work completed through reusable components or AI\-assisted workflows, cost per page or funnel, and marketing launch delays caused by technology or creative dependencies. These metrics exist to improve the system, not to generate reporting.


How Success Will Be Measured


Your first thirty days are about establishing a baseline. We do not currently measure cycle time, waiting time, clarification loops, rework or escaped defects, so your first task is to map the current state from request to launch and put real numbers against it, then produce a prioritized roadmap for improving the system. We would rather agree ambitious targets against real data than hand you numbers invented before anyone measured anything.


By sixty days we expect a standardized intake and requirements process, clear Definitions of Ready and Done, service\-level expectations by category of work, visibility over development and creative capacity, dependency planning across copy, design, video, development, tracking and approvals, piloted AI\-assisted and template\-driven workflows, and a live operating dashboard covering speed, quality and throughput.


By ninety days we expect the function to be trending strongly toward a materially shorter median request\-to\-launch cycle time, the large majority of work delivered by the committed date, the large majority of work passing final QC without another development round, a sharp reduction in issues identified after approval by the CEO or the media buyer, full visibility over active work, dependencies, blockers and capacity, standard page types produced without bespoke development, and higher throughput without a corresponding increase in headcount. Exact targets will be finalized against your baseline.  

  

What We Are Looking For


Significant experience improving the operations of a web development, digital production or growth technology team, with a proven record of reducing delivery time, increasing throughput or improving first\-pass quality. Experience in an environment where development speed directly affects revenue. A strong working understanding of landing pages, ecommerce funnels, checkouts, upsells, testing and conversion\-focused web production.


Enough technical depth to challenge estimates, architecture choices and development approaches, including a working understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs, analytics, tracking, page builders and modern web development workflows. Experience implementing AI tools or automation inside a real production environment rather than as a pilot or a talking point. Experience designing intake processes, acceptance criteria, capacity planning and quality control systems, and a strong grasp of dependencies and constraint management.


The ability to communicate effectively with marketers, copywriters, designers, media buyers and developers, and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when a requirement is unclear, unnecessarily complicated or being solved in the wrong way. Strong analytical ability, comfort making decisions from operational data, and a bias toward simplification, standardization and measurable results.


Experience with direct response ecommerce, high\-volume web production, Shopify, Checkout Champ, Figma, landing page builders, CRO testing and marketing analytics is highly advantageous. Formal qualifications are not required where there is strong evidence of relevant outcomes. You must be able to overlap consistently with our collaboration window of 8:00am to 12:00pm EST.


This Role Is Not


This is not a traditional cloud\-infrastructure DevOps role, a Jira administration role, a project coordinator position, or a role focused on running agile ceremonies. It is not a role for someone who accepts every requirement without questioning it, whose first answer to any constraint is additional headcount, who can describe AI tools but has never embedded them into an operational workflow, or who wants engineering leadership disconnected from marketing and revenue.

 **Benefits**  

What We Offer


A fully remote senior position with genuine ownership of a function that directly determines how fast the business can move. We offer paid time off, a monthly wellness stipend, medical insurance support, a company\-funded computer allowance after a tenure milestone, a birthday gift card, an in\-country meetup allowance, and participation in company\-funded leadership offsites. You will have direct access to the founders, a high\-volume testing environment, and the mandate to build the system rather than inherit someone else's process.

title: Director of ERP Integrations
description:
**Join BLP Digital — The \#1 Solution for ERP Automation**


BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting\-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.


Our solution is live in 40\+ countries, used by 550\+ customers, and automates 70,000\+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest\-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product\-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.


We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? *Join BLP Digital today.*

**The Team and the Challenge**


BLP runs two ERP integration teams: one focused on SAP and the team you would lead, which owns every other ERP. Your team builds and maintains the integrations that carry live ERP data into the BLP platform and back, all mapped to our canonical data model.

**The ERP landscape you own**


The team already runs a mature portfolio of more than 30 live ERP integrations, so you would own and extend an established base rather than start from scratch. It spans Microsoft Dynamics NAV and Business Central (on\-premise and cloud), Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations, Infor LN, Infor M3, Abas, Oracle NetSuite, and Oracle JD Edwards with new systems added as the customer base grows.

**The integration patterns you own**


The work spans on\-premise connectors, customer\-exposed REST APIs, locally hosted REST APIs, and file\-based exchanges. No two customers look the same, and the US mid\-market in particular is deeply fragmented. Turning that variety into a reliable, repeatable, well\-documented product is the core of the role.

**What You Will Do**

**Build and scale the team**

* Grow the team from roughly 10 to 50 engineers, hiring, structuring squads, and developing team leads beneath you.
* Design a team model that scales sustainably, including distributed and near\-shore delivery where it makes sense.

**Own the technical direction**

* Set the architecture and standards for connectors across on\-premise, cloud, REST, and file\-based patterns.
* Drive reusability and a consistent approach to mapping ERP data onto the BLP data model.
* Uphold BLP's bar for enterprise\-grade reliability, governance, and full audit trails.

**Drive documentation and process**

* Establish the documentation, playbooks, and engineering processes that let a 50\-person team move fast without losing quality.
* Build onboarding and knowledge\-sharing so new engineers reach productivity quickly.

**Engage senior customer stakeholders**

* Represent BLP in technical conversations with senior stakeholders at enterprise customers, including CIOs, IT directors, and enterprise architects.
* Scope integration solutions, set expectations, and build trust through delivery.

**Master the US market**

* Be the person who understands the fragmented US ERP landscape and turns it into a competitive advantage for BLP.
* Partner closely with our US go\-to\-market and delivery teams.

**What You Bring**

**Must have:**

* 8\+ years in software or integration engineering, including several years leading engineering teams, with a proven track record of scaling a team well beyond 20 people.
* Deep, hands\-on ERP integration experience, with direct exposure to several of: Microsoft Dynamics (NAV, Business Central, D365 F\&O), Infor LN or M3, Oracle NetSuite or JD Edwards, Abas.
* Fluency across integration patterns: on\-premise connectors and agents, REST APIs, and file or EDI exchange, with strong instincts for data mapping to a canonical model.
* Direct experience with the US mid\-market ERP landscape and its fragmentation.
* Excellent stakeholder management: comfortable and credible with senior customer technical leaders.
* A demonstrated record of building documentation, standards, and repeatable processes, not just shipping features.
* Fluent English and willingness to travel to customers and BLP sites.

**Nice to have:**

* Background at an integration platform (iPaaS), AP or finance automation, or another B2B SaaS company that integrates broadly with ERPs.
* .NET / C\# familiarity, common in the Dynamics connector world, and exposure to EDI standards.
* Experience building and leading distributed or near\-shore engineering teams.
* German is a plus.

**Location, Reporting and What We Offer**


This role can be based onsite at a BLP office or worked fully remotely. Some travel to customers and BLP sites is expected. The role reports directly to the Founder \& CTO.

* Direct ownership of a high\-visibility function at a fast\-growing enterprise AI company.
* The mandate and resources to build a 50\-person team and shape how it works.
* A collaborative, senior peer group and direct access to leadership.
* Competitive compensation aligned with the hiring location.

title: Director of Product - RPG
description:
**Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love.** We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top\-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.  

  

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built\-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass\-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.  

  

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.  

  

What powers the loop is talent density. 220\+ people from 30\+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.
  

  

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.  

  

At Homa, we are building the next billion\-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**Mission**As a **Director of Product** on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end\-to\-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with that game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.


Your main responsibilities will include:

* **Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles:** core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in\-game economy.
* **Own LiveOps end\-to\-end.** You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
* **Lead your team.** You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
* **Oversee the monetization model.** Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
* **Drive growth, in partnership with UA.** You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand\-in\-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
* **Cross\-functional excellence.** You'll work hand\-in\-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end\-to\-end, from concept to launch.
* **Set the bar.** Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
* **Stay hands\-on when it counts.** This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.


This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy,, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

 **Requirements**  

We are looking for someone with **several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG,** with genuine end\-to\-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

**Product \& RPG expertise**

* P**roduct experience on live F2P mobile games**, ideally RPG/midcore, with end\-to\-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
* Strong fluency in **RPG mechanics and meta systems:** progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
* Ideally, you’ve taken a title **from concept/pre\-launch through launch and LiveOps**, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

**LiveOps \& Execution**

* Deep **LiveOps experience**, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
* Strong track record **owning features end\-to\-end**: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of **what a live team can realistically ship and maintain**, balancing ambition with feasibility.

**Leadership \& Ways of working**

* Strong **cross\-functional leadership**, able to align Design, Publishing, Data, Economy, UA, Growth and external studios around the product direction.
* A **strategist and builder**: able to set direction and lead others, while remaining highly hands\-on with the game, systems and data.
* Thrives in **lean, fast\-moving, high\-autonomy teams** with quick tests, short feedback loops and high ownership.

  

**Our Culture**
At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

* **Ambition**: We strive for the best \- we don’t settle for “good enough.”
* **Humility**: We recognize that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
* **Curiosity**: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what”.
* **Focus**: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider \- we dive deep into the details.

  

**Benefits**  

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
* **Paris HQ Access:** Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well\-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
* **Coworking Access:** You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
* **Global Team:** Collaborate in English with top\-tier talent from 35\+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
* ✈️ **Team Gatherings:** We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off\-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
* **Performance Reviews:** We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
* **Equipment Support:** From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.


Where We Hire
Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after\-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy \- all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).


We also have incredible team members across Europe \- from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC\+3\). If you're based there \- or planning to be \- we’d love to hear from you!

*Please note: this is one remote position open to multiple countries, not multiple openings.*

title: Associate Director, Retention
description:
**About Darkroom**
------------------


Darkroom is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the role**
------------------


We are hiring a Senior Manager, Retention—a seasoned CRM strategist and operator who brings equal parts creativity, technical depth, and leadership maturity to the table. This is not a maintenance role; it requires strategic ownership, hands\-on execution, and a bias for measurable impact. You'll lead a team of lifecycle marketing experts to build sophisticated email, SMS, and loyalty programs that drive retention, increase LTV, and power sustained growth for a portfolio of fast\-scaling e\-commerce brands. This role demands sharp customer insight to turn data into strategy, comfort with complexity, and the ability to influence clients and internal stakeholders alike. You'll report to our Director of Retention and collaborate closely with Performance, Creative, and Strategy teams to deliver cohesive, cross\-channel campaigns rooted in data and customer psychology.


Darkroom is a career accelerator for retention marketers who want to do the best work of their careers—operating at the intersection of personalization, loyalty, and performance\-driven innovation.


This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Mexico, Brazil, and Spain.

**You Should Apply if this sounds like you:**
---------------------------------------------


You're passionate about e\-commerce and digital marketing. You're immersed in the world of direct\-to\-consumer growth marketing. We're looking for an expert Senior Manager, Retention to join our team! In this role, you will join a growing team within the Retention Marketing Department to strategically develop customized CRM and retention marketing strategies that help our clients grow and scale through email and SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs.

* 7\+ years of work experience in digital marketing. You're passionate about developing creative customer journeys that drive loyalty and lifetime value.

*Channel \& Strategy Expertise*

* You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e\-commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
* You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events, plus working knowledge of Shopify and its tech stack (Octane AI, Okendo, Privy, Alia, Lifetimely).
* You develop SMS strategies that respect the channel, including segmentation, cadence, and compliance, with experience in platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
* You design loyalty programs that meaningfully enhance LTV, from earn\-and\-burn mechanics to tier structure and program launch (Rivo, Smile.io, Yotpo).
* You think in subscription lifecycles and know how email and SMS drive sign\-ups, reduce cancellations, and win back lapsed subscribers, with experience in platforms such as Recharge, Stay.ai, Loop, or Skio.
* You're fluent in retention measurement, including cohort analysis, repeat purchase rate, and LTV:CAC, and you use it to prioritize where to invest next.

*Leadership \& Team Development*

* You're passionate about building teams, training them on best practices, and helping them grow into experts.
* You've had at least one direct report before, OR exceptional leadership skills working with cross\-functional teams.
* You're used to working in a fast\-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team, and your clients.

*How You Work*

* You love making data\-driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable email and SMS strategies that drive client revenue.
* You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

**A Day in the Life:**
----------------------

* Serve as the senior point of contact for select clients, working to develop best\-in\-class retention strategies. On a weekly basis, you will meet with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
* Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients' email and SMS programs.
* Provide support and guidance to help Retention Specialists analyze data, develop winning retention strategies and create reports for clients happiness.
* Project manage and delegate client tasks to your team, consisting of both specialists and designers. Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client.
* Coordinate cross\-departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams to develop cohesive and creative campaigns that drive client growth.
* Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
* Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
* Execute on automation/flow logic set\-up, pop\-up builds, and app integrations.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* Remote\-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.
* Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
**About Block Labs**
====================


Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of **Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming**. We don't just ship features; we engineer high\-scale, production\-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products.


We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi\-agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high\-frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence.


We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong.

**The Role**
============


We are investing in governed AI agents that work directly with our customers and internal teams. Data \& Intelligence now sits at the centre of several products we are developing, and the platform we have built is ready to carry more advanced intelligence: real\-time decisioning, predictive modelling, and governed AI agents.


This role reflects that shift. Our decision engine is governed by a formal decision register: over 100 decisions across 15 platform modules, spanning real\-time risk gates, reward and engagement orchestration, payment routing, treasury alerting, and responsible gambling interventions. Humans set objectives, budgets and approval gates; AI and ML models author, score, simulate and optimise within them; the engine executes deterministically inside approved boundaries and logs everything. As an AI Engineer on the Intelligence team, you are the product engineer of the data and agent platform. You build production agents that answer real business questions and, as they earn autonomy, act with real customers and real money: grounded, auditable, secured against adversarial input, and gated by human approval where the stakes demand it. And you build the intelligence underneath and around them: the models and analyses that power decisions, and the dashboards where the business sees and steers everything, on a platform where a wrong decision can move money and every decision must be reconstructable.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================


Your first deliverable is a production SQL BI analyst agent: a Slack\-native agent that answers business questions with governed SQL over the analytical warehouse, with validated queries, sanity\-checked results, and cited evidence behind every number. From there, the role balances four crafts in roughly equal measure: AI agents, machine learning, data science, and the dashboards and surfaces that expose them.

**AI Agents**
-------------

* Build and own analyst agents end to end: Slack\-native agents that translate natural\-language business questions into governed SQL over the analytical warehouse, answer executive P\&L questions, post daily health briefings, and explain metric movements with data\-backed root cause analysis; guarded by SQL and schema validation, result sanity checks, and cross\-checks of daily metrics against canonical reporting views.
* Extend into customer\-facing agents: intent triage and routing, retrieval\-grounded (RAG) responses over versioned knowledge bases with strict abort\-and\-escalate fallbacks, multi\-turn conversational state machines, localized brand voice, and escalation logic; integrated with our helpdesk and CRM platforms (webhook ingestion, session lifecycle management, intent metadata tagging, automated escalation tickets with pre\-packaged tool context).
* Build the risk\-stratified tool layer between agents and back\-office APIs: read\-only context\-gathering tools, information\-first validation before any action, multi\-turn confirmation workflows, and a per\-tool switch that moves low\-risk mutations from lead approval to fully autonomous execution as evidence accumulates. Harden agents against adversarial input: prompt injection screening, confidence\-threshold freezes on sensitive intents, silent security escalation paths, and defences against tool misuse and data exfiltration.
* Build agents up the autonomy ladder using LangGraph, the Anthropic Agent SDK / Model Context Protocol (MCP), or equivalent orchestration frameworks. Engineer the closed feedback loop (corrections capture, proven\-query and semantic memory), decision audit logging, and evaluation harnesses, including regression suites proving new tools or intents introduce zero degradation to existing paths.

**Machine Learning**
--------------------

* Build and productionise the models behind the platform's decision signals: churn, lifetime value, and bonus\-sensitivity models for engagement; composite player risk scores across identity, payment, gameplay, bonus, and network signals; collusion, bot\-play, and multi\-accounting detection; and anomaly detection for treasury and payments.
* Ship models as governed signals, not notebooks: versioned, SLA'd contracts with the decision engine and your agents, with freshness, drift, and calibration monitoring and automated retraining paths, served across real\-time (Kafka/MSK), near\-real\-time, and batch (ClickHouse) tiers.

**Data Science**
----------------

* Own multi\-vector withdrawal risk scoring: per\-vector scores with cited rationale and confidence, evidence\-aware aggregation, and automatic re\-scoring when late evidence lands.
* Codify business rules with domain owners and keep policy auditable: translate policy into deterministic, configurable rules; simulate and backtest every rule or threshold change against historical data before activation; design holdouts and control groups to measure true uplift; and run the deep\-dive analyses that feed both your agents and the executive team.

**Dashboards \& Surfaces**
--------------------------

* Build the supervisor and approval surfaces for your agents: review queues with one\-click action proposal cards for high\-risk mutations, searchable session replay exposing prompts, model outputs, reasoning chains, and tool calls, and a structured grading module whose output feeds evaluation and fine\-tuning datasets.
* Design and ship the dashboards through which the business consumes your work: decision audit views, agent performance dashboards (correction rate, failure rate, decision volume by rule and vector), risk review queues, and KPI views built with the BI team, moving dashboarding toward AI\-assisted anomaly detection and explanation.

**About You:**
==============

* 4\+ years of experience in software, data science, or machine learning engineering, including 1\+ years building LLM\-powered agents in production: tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval and memory, and multi\-step orchestration with frameworks such as LangGraph or the Anthropic Agent SDK.
* You have shipped a production RAG system and can talk concretely about grounding, chunking and retrieval quality, hallucination control, and when to refuse to answer.
* You treat customer\-facing agents as an attack surface: you can explain how you would defend against prompt injection, tool\-call abuse, and data leakage through model outputs.
* Production ML lifecycle ownership: feature engineering, training, serving, monitoring, and retraining. Fraud, risk, or abuse detection experience is a strong signal: imbalanced classes, adversarial users, and cost\-asymmetric decisions.
* Statistical rigour: experiment design, holdouts and control groups, uplift measurement, and score calibration; you can defend a threshold choice to a compliance officer as comfortably as to an engineer.
* Evaluation discipline for non\-deterministic systems: you have built evaluation harnesses and regression suites and caught quality drift before your users did.
* Strong Python for production services, comfort in TypeScript for the review and approval surfaces you will ship, and strong SQL skills on columnar analytical databases (ClickHouse preferred).
* Able to take your own work to a stakeholder\-ready surface: review queues, approval interfaces, dashboards, and lightweight internal apps, using a front\-end framework or tools such as Streamlit. You do not wait for another team to make your work visible.
* Experience designing systems where model outputs feed deterministic execution, keeping that boundary clean (models score, suggest, and draft; governed logic decides), with LLM observability and tracing (Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar) and ownership of what you ship, including when it breaks.

**Nice to Have**
================

* Experience in iGaming or other high\-trust, transaction\-intensive environments where security, fraud prevention, auditability, traceability, data integrity, and robust operational controls are core engineering requirements.
* Helpdesk or CS\-platform integration experience (Intercom, Zendesk, or similar): webhooks, conversation APIs, agent\-assist, or full automation.
* Exposure to blockchain or crypto\-native transaction flows, including on\-chain data, wallet clustering, or stablecoin settlement.
* Experience with constrained optimisation, bandits, or reinforcement learning applied within hard business constraints (budgets, caps, exclusion lists).
* Experience with rule engines or decision\-management systems, and Slack app development.
* Event\-driven and streaming experience: Kafka or MSK consumers, idempotent processing, and failure handling.

**How We Work**
===============

* Fully remote with asynchronous\-first communication. EU timezone overlap is preferred.
* Small, high\-autonomy Intelligence team within the Data function. You report to the Head of Data and coordinate with the AI, BI, and Infrastructure Teams and, for customer\-facing agents, with the Head of CS and the product squads whose platforms your agents serve.
* Architecture decisions are documented and debated. You will participate in design reviews and own your domain decisions.
* Autonomy is earned by evidence. Models and agents start in propose\-only, human\-gated mode and graduate one level at a time, backed by simulation and outcome data.
* We build for multi\-tenant scale from day one. What you ship for one operator must absorb the next without additional engineering effort.

**What kind of culture can I expect?**  

Mature, mission\-driven, and low\-ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here.

-------------------

* Own the end\-to\-end journey for custom and high\-value regional requests, from initial qualification and proposal design to closing the sale and identifying upsell opportunities.
* Serve as the primary, proactive contact for clients and advisors, ensuring all proposals are commercially sound, operationally feasible, and accurately tracked.

* Monitor backend configurations and flag seasonality risks or portfolio gaps before they impact bookings.
* Manage 1:1 expert communications and build trusted relationships with the regional community, thoughtfully matching experts to clients based on context and expertise.
* Provide clear briefings on custom content and collect expert feedback to drive continuous product improvement.
* Triage the regional inbox daily by urgency and value, maintaining strict data hygiene through consistent tagging and accurate information transfer.
* Maintain communication templates and canned responses to ensure high\-quality, reportable regional data.
* Analyze regional trends and root causes to identify client and operational pain points, providing actionable recommendations for cross\-functional resolution.
* Fluently utilize the tech stack and AI tools to optimize drafting, research, and data tasks, sharing best practices with the team.
* Design, document, and lead new regional workflows and efficiency projects to improve the overall client experience.
* Mentor and train seasonal contractors and Delivery colleagues.
* Support onboarding of new regional teammates and act as a resource for best practice.
* Actively contribute to weekly Delivery team and cross\-regional meetings.

* **Portfolio depth.** Knows the Italian, Greek, Turkey and Africa product well enough to answer most questions without escalating.
* **Technical fluency.** Adopts tools, including AI, and turns them into time saved for the whole team.
* **Data discipline.** Tags, records, and reports accurately, so regional decisions are based on real numbers.
* **Pattern recognition.** Sees the trend behind the individual complaint and proposes the structural fix.
* **Expert relationships.** Trusted by the expert community, and able to brief them well under time pressure.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**
---------------------

**Required**

* 2\+ of experience in travel, hospitality, or a comparable client\-facing commercial role.
* Proven experience selling or building custom, high\-value travel or service proposals with an eagerness to close the sale and celebrate the win
* Native\-level English and Italian written and spoken (required), with strong professional judgement in sensitive client and expert\-facing communications
* Deep familiarity with and passion for Italy (required), including 3\+ years lived or directly relevant professional experience, with a knack for inspiring others to visit.
* Demonstrated autonomous ownership: can triage, decide, and close loops without heavy supervision.Sincere enthusiasm for connecting with clients both via email and over the phone
* Confident with CRM, booking, and communication platforms; fast to learn new systems.
* Comfortable working with data: building a report, reading it, and explaining what it means.
* You are someone who does not stop at the task in front of them. This person spots patterns, brings them to the team, and proposes the process or the tool that fixes the problem for good. Comfort with technology — including AI tools — is central to the role, not a nice to have.
* Resilience and composure—you handle unhappy clients with empathy and a thick skin
* Cultural sensitivity—you have experience and/or interest in working with colleagues and people from around the globe
* A curious, learning\-driven mindset—you’d happily be one of our clients yourself

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of Greece or other Southern Europe destinations.
* Greek or another regional language.
* Experience writing SOPs or training material.
* Background in cultural heritage, art history, archaeology, or a related field.

**In exchange, we are thrilled to offer:**

* A supportive, mission\-oriented work environment with colleagues who care
* Unlimited access to digital lectures and, audio guides, and in\-person small group tours
* Annual enrichment stipend to pursue personal and professional interests
* Tech stipend
