title: Senior Product Designer - App Experience (Independent Contractor)
description:
**Location**
------------


UK; European Union


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


Remote


**Department**
--------------


Design


  
**Design the experiences that help people understand what to eat, and why, to improve their gut health.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ZOE turns world\-leading gut health science into an app people use every day. As a Senior Product Designer you'll own some of the key surfaces, taking loosely defined problems and exploring widely before narrowing in on something worth building. We're looking for real creative range, strong product judgement and exceptional craft — and someone who knows when to keep pushing and when to ship.  

  



**About ZOE**
-------------


ZOE is a gut health science company that turns world\-leading science into everyday gut\-health products. The ZOE app helps you understand what you eat and how it affects your body — so you can build healthier habits and improve your gut health over time. It's like having a personal nutrition coach in your pocket!  

  



**About the team**
------------------


You'll join our Product Design team on a 3\-6 month Fixed Term Contract or Temp\-to\-Perm basis. We're a small, multi\-disciplinary group of Product, Content and Motion Designers, and UX Researchers who care deeply about solving user problems, creating joyful experiences, and keeping a high bar for craft. We challenge each other, learn together, and believe great work should be fun.  



* **️ About the role**


You’ll be embedded in our Core Experience team, partnering with Product, Engineering and Data Analytics to own meaningful areas of the ZOE app end\-to\-end, from ambiguous problem to shipped experience.


This is a senior individual contributor role. You’ll own complex, strategically important work with little day\-to\-day direction, and be trusted to set the direction within your areas and to bring the team with you.


You’ll work across both big and small bets: improving existing journeys, but also taking loosely defined problems and generating a wide range of concepts and directions before narrowing in. We’re looking for someone genuinely creative — who can move quickly when the problem is clear, and open it right up when it isn’t. **This is not a role for someone who only wants to optimise.**


We take a scientific approach, so much of what we ship gets A/B tested. You’ll need strong design convictions, while being willing to let evidence change your mind.  

  



**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------


**Shape the right solution**


* Turn loosely defined problems into clear, compelling product experiences.
* Explore genuinely different directions before converging, and challenge the initial hypothesis when needed.
* Move comfortably between big bets and small experiments, knowing when to explore broadly and when to make a focused improvement quickly.
* Bring strong product judgement, grounded in a real understanding of our users, our science and the wider market: know what matters, make sensible trade\-offs, and know when to keep exploring versus move forward.
* Work with Product and Data Analytics to shape A/B tests, understand what moved the needle and use the results to decide what happens next.

**Create exceptional app experiences**


* Design high\-quality native experiences for iOS and Android, with strong visual and interaction craft.
* Translate complex behavioural and scientific concepts into experiences that feel simple, engaging and motivating.
* Make data feel rewarding and valuable rather than clinical — scores, trends and states understood at a glance, so people feel encouraged, not judged.
* Prototype to test ideas and answer questions, not just present solutions.
* Work closely with engineers through implementation, keeping the experience coherent with patterns across the rest of the app and contributing to our Design System.

**Own work through to impact**


* Create momentum and keep work moving: set clear expectations with your team and stakeholders, and keep people informed as things progress.
* Make your thinking easy to follow — explain complex problems and design decisions so the wider team can make good calls, and bring people with you rather than presenting at them.
* Run usability testing and turn findings into clear recommendations, partnering with UX Research when needed.
* Understand how your work performs after launch and use what you learn to improve it.
* Raise the bar around you: set the standard through your own work, share what you learn, and help improve how we work as a team.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------


* Have strong end\-to\-end consumer native app work in your portfolio, and can talk honestly about it — the thinking, the trade\-offs, what you cut and what you’d do differently.
* Are genuinely creative — you generate real range, not variations on one idea.
* Are energised by ambiguity and comfortable questioning the idea you were handed.
* Have experience designing for habit or behaviour change.
* Think in user problems, flows and behaviours rather than screens.
* Have strong product judgement and can balance user needs, business goals, evidence and craft.
* Communicate with clarity and bring people with you — your thinking is easy to follow, challenge and build on.
* Can independently take work from an ambiguous starting point through to a high\-quality shipped experience.
* Are low\-ego, pragmatic and take ownership through to the end.
* Use AI tools where they genuinely make you better or faster, and know where they don’t.

**Why join ZOE?**
-----------------


* **Genuinely remote\-first.** We’re built around trust, autonomy and async working.
* Work on meaningful problems with real impact on people’s health.
* Shape critical member journeys at a pivotal stage of growth.
* Collaborate with world\-class scientists, designers and technologists.

**✨ Our Hiring Journey**
------------------------


We value your time. While the exact steps and timeline can vary slightly depending on the role, seniority, and team, we’ve designed a streamlined **4\-step blueprint** to get us from *"Hello"* to *"Welcome to the team"* as efficiently as possible:


* **Intro Chat with the Talent Team:** A high\-energy alignment check to learn about you and share our vision.
* **Hiring Manager Interview:** A tactical conversation focused on your craft, experience, and aspirations.
* **The Remote Loop:** 2 to 4 focused interviews assessing your technical expertise, behavioural approach, and collaboration style.
* **Offer \& Welcome:** Finalising the details and getting you ready to hit the ground running!
Once we connect, we pride ourselves on moving fast. Our average hiring process takes between **20 to 30 days**, depending on the complexity of the role.


We love momentum, but we’re always happy to adjust the timeline to match your schedule and personal preference.

**Ready to thrive? Apply Now**
------------------------------


If you are genuinely excited about ZOE's mission and this opportunity, please don't hesitate to apply—even if you don't meet every single requirement listed. We fundamentally value potential and commitment above all else.


*ZOE is an equal opportunity employer. If you require any reasonable accommodations during the interview process, just let us know—we are here to support you.*

The Business Planning team is responsible for maximizing the commercial potential of Contentsquare’s product portfolio. The team develops and evolves the company’s business models, pricing, packaging, licensing, and commercial frameworks across products, segments, industries, geographies, and channels.

As a **Business Planning Analyst**, you will bring analytical rigor and operational discipline to the team’s pricing and packaging work at every stage of the business model lifecycle. This includes:


* Providing data and market\-driven insights and analysis to support business model creation.
* Translating business requirements to program and engineering teams to facilitate the operationalization of business models in our systems.
* Supporting sales teams with tools and resources.
* Building and supporting a data\-driven feedback loop that measures business model performance and informs where pricing or packaging changes may support revenue growth.
### **What you’ll do**


* **Support business model creation.** Deliver insights based on data and market analysis in support of the business model design and decision making process.
* **Analyze commercial performance.** Evaluate commercial metrics (revenue, ARR, churn, pipeline) to spot trends and optimize pricing and packaging via clear executive models and recommendations.
* **Link product usage to revenue.** Merge product usage data with commercial metrics to understand retention and value. Partner with Product and Analytics to define key performance drivers.
* **Executive Communication.** Maintain dashboards tracking pricing efficacy and lead quarterly business reviews with data\-driven leadership summaries.
* **Track competitive market dynamics.** Monitor competitor models, pricing, and packaging to sharpen Contentsquare’s market position and commercial strategy.
* **Operationalize business models.** Translate pricing decisions into requirements for CPQ, Product, and RevOps, managing SKUs, quoting workflows, and UAT for seamless execution.

* 5 years of experience in facilities maintenance or equivalent related functions.

* Commercial and customer service awareness
* Organisation, time management, prioritising and the ability to handle various things at the same time.
* Good knowledge of IT packages.
* Fluent Spanish and English is a must.
### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.  



If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV!


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

Reporting into the Head of Corporate Functions (CF) Technology, you will be embedded in the area where AI adoption needs to happen. You will help create and nurture the Corporate Functions AI Community of Practice, so that knowledge, experimentation, and adoption are shared across teams rather than remaining isolated in individual pockets.


**Your responsibilities –**

* Act as the primary AI champion embedded within the delivery and operational teams, working alongside engineers, analysts, and delivery leads to embed AI into everyday practice.

title: Lifestyle Agent
description:
**THE RESIDENCES**


Mandarin Oriental has experienced exponential growth in the development of The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, in combination with hotels, to form complex mixed\-use and stand\-alone projects. Integral to the growth of the Mandarin Oriental footprint, Residences are a new paradigm, and as such require focused operational expertise. In addition to the goal of delivering superior experiences and services to Residences owners, Mandarin Oriental is focused not only on the management of the Residences common areas to the very high standards our guests have become accustomed, but to continually improving our relationship with Residence owners over the long term.

  

**STRATEGIC INTENT**


The mission of this position is for the incumbent to assume full responsibility for all aspects of residential services, concierge operations, and the lifestyle experience of our residents during both the pre\-opening and post\-opening phases.


The ideal candidate will be proactive, creative, and resident\-centric, with a strong focus on excellence and operational efficiency. They must consistently keep the residents’ perspective in mind when delivering services and products and always represent the brand with professionalism and integrity. This role also serves as a key development opportunity for operations\-focused professionals aspiring to advance into positions within Group Residences or Hotel operations across MOHG projects.


The incumbent is expected to demonstrate tenacity, creativity, flexibility, and unwavering commitment to ensure a successful residential launch, strategic positioning, and continued operation — all delivered on budget and on time.  



**SCOPE OF POSITION / SUMMARY**


The Lifestyle Attendant is responsible for the organisation, coordination, monitoring and maintaining of their shift to ensure a smooth and efficient operation of all the exclusive Amenities including the Fitness Center, Spa facilities, the indoor and outdoor pool, the meeting room, the lounge areas, the library, the Golf Simulator and wet\-areas of the residences and any other health / outdoor activities provided.  

  

  



Also, the Lifestyle Agent is responsible for assisting and supporting Residential Concierge and Residential Porter with their full scope of duties duties.

  



**ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE**

  



The Lifestyle Attendant reports to Lead Concierge and subsequently to the Director of Residences.

  



**DUTIES AND SUPPORTING RESPONSIBILITIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent responsibilities:  

  

  



* Effectively coordinates the usage of the Lifestyle area and Community activities.
* Review the cleanliness of the exclusive Amenities during the shift and maintain it in accordance with MOHG Standards (i.e. set up of treatment room, maintain the stock of towels, water, etc… at the fitness centre and changing rooms, disinfection of fitness equipment, etc…)
* Proactively greet, interact, and assist residence owners in a professional manner.
* Identify and report defects throughout the residential area; notify the Residences Management team immediately of hazards, injuries, equipment or processes that negatively affect the operations.
* Report all requests and complaints to the Residences Management team to ensure issues are resolved immediately and followed up to ensure the resident’s satisfaction.
* To aid therapists and private practitioners in setting up for treatments as well as clearing away after.
* To ensure that lockers are stocked with clean linen at all times and removing soiled items.
* To ensure fitness center is always clean and with sufficient stock of towels, drinks, etc…
* Make sure all equipment at fitness center is disinfected after every use.
* To attend to residents in all areas, ensuring that they are comfortable as well as offering refreshments.
* Be knowledgeable with AV equipment and be able to set up equipment on demand.
* Maintain complete knowledge and comply with all residential and Management Company departmental policies and procedures.
* Maintain correct records for FLHSS audit.
* Maintain strict confidentiality relative to Residents and Residences business.
* Practice teamwork, create a positive work environment, greet fellow employees and thank them when they lend assistance.
* Proactively seek to provide refined luxury service ensuring resident satisfaction.
* Ability to focus attention on resident needs, remaining calm and courteous.
* Assist Residential Concierge in any duty deemed appropriate by the Concierge such as the delivery / pick up / purchase of desk services, for those services that need to be performed away from the desk such as deliveries of food, laundry, etc…
* Anticipate residents’ needs, respond promptly and acknowledge all residents, however busy and whatever time of day.
* Accommodate all Residents requests expediently and courteously. Follow up with designated Residential or Management Company personnel to ensure completion of request.
* Protect and utilise Management Company assets in a responsible and professional manner.
* Participate in the property’s sustainability initiative through energy conservation and the use of recycling programs and materials.
* Always show a professional attitude, particularly with regard to punctuality, appearance and general manner.
* Provide food and beverage service upon resident request, ensuring a seamless and personalized experience.
* To carry out any other reasonable requests as directed by your manager.

  



**REQUIREMENTS ON CORE COMPETENCIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent requires the following personal attributes:


* Delighting our Customers


* Delighting our Colleagues


* Communicates a compelling vision
* Inspires co\-operation and commitment
* Adapts work style and ethics appropriately
* Actively listens and builds on other ideas
* Effectively understands and uses resources
* Is culturally sensitive
* Good written and verbal skills

  



* Becoming the Best


* Achievement orientated
* Makes things happen
* Has presence
* Has positive impact and influence
* Generates, innovative options
* Adapts plans to suit change
* Seeks continuous improvement opportunities

  



* Working together


* Has energy and drive
* A sense of urgency
* Motivating individual
* Communicates clearly
* Open to feedback and learning
* Operates ethically
* High level of personal integrity


* Acting with Responsibility


* Can identify core issues and problems
* Emotionally stable and mature
* Accepts feedback
* Coaches others
* Manages responsibilities

  



**Requirements – Experience, Skills, Education and Qualifications**
-------------------------------------------------------------------


* Have a minimum of one year’s experience in similar position, preferably in a luxury environment.
* Excellent communication skills in all aspects.
* To be passionate about delivering the very best recreation, fitness and leisure experience for your residents.
* Approachable, confident, composed, and is able to work well in a team environment.
* Flexible work hours to meet the demands of the operation.
* Good verbal skills in Spanish and English.

Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next…


From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Join Warner Bros. Pictures and play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering publicity campaigns for the theatrical slate in Spain. Working closely with the Senior Director of Publicity, Italy and Spain, you will ensure campaigns are culturally relevant, aligned with international objectives, and generate meaningful audience engagement and earned media impact.
If you are passionate about entertainment publicity, thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy working across high\-profile film releases, we would love to hear from you.**Your Role Accountabilities*** Oversee Spanish publicity campaigns from strategy through execution, localising global plans to maximise relevance and impact within the Spanish market while identifying creative opportunities that drive earned media coverage and audience engagement.

* Coordinate the Spanish publicity budget, monitor campaign performance against agreed objectives and KPIs, and provide clear status updates to senior stakeholders.

description:
**About Nômade Temple Madrid**


Nômade Temple Madrid is more than a space, it is a vibrant hub where community, creativity, and conscious living meet in the heart of the city. Inspired by the bohemian and soulful essence of the Nômade universe, we bring together gastronomy, culture, wellness, and lifestyle to create meaningful and elevated experiences.

**Your role**


As **F\&B Director**, you will be responsible for leading the overall Food \& Beverage strategy and operation at Nômade Temple Madrid, overseeing our restaurants, bars, events, and F\&B experiences while ensuring that each outlet reflects the Nômade philosophy and achieves the highest standards of guest experience, operational excellence, team engagement, and financial performance. Working closely with the General Manager and the leadership team, you will drive the commercial and operational performance of the department, identify new opportunities, develop innovative concepts, optimize revenue and profitability, and lead a high\-performing team that delivers authentic, memorable, and distinctive hospitality experiences.

**What you will do**

* Define and lead the overall Food \& Beverage strategy for Nômade Temple Madrid, aligned with the brand vision and business objectives.
* Oversee the daily operation and performance of all F\&B outlets, ensuring consistency in service, quality, presentation, and guest experience.
* Develop and implement annual F\&B budgets, business plans, revenue strategies, and operational objectives.
* Drive profitability through effective management of revenue, food cost, beverage cost, labor cost, productivity, and operational expenses.
* Monitor key F\&B performance indicators and develop action plans to maximize revenue and profitability.
* Lead the development and continuous evolution of our restaurant, bar, rooftop, event, and other F\&B concepts.
* Ensure that each outlet has a clear identity while maintaining a consistent Nômade approach to hospitality.
* Collaborate closely with the Executive Chef and culinary leadership to develop menus, concepts, pricing strategies, and gastronomic experiences.
* Work together with Marketing, Events, Wellness, Sales, and Operations teams to create innovative experiences and activations that connect with our guests and community.
* Build strong relationships with suppliers, partners, producers, and external collaborators.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding, training, development, and succession planning across the F\&B department.
* Inspire and develop F\&B leaders, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, creativity, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and maintain service standards, operational procedures, and quality benchmarks across all F\&B areas.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, health \& safety, licensing, and company standards.
* Analyze guest feedback, market trends, and industry developments to continuously improve the F\&B offering.
* Identify new commercial opportunities and partnerships that can increase revenue and strengthen the positioning of Nômade Temple Madrid.
* Represent the F\&B department within the hotel's leadership team and act as an ambassador of the Nômade brand.
* Contribute to the long\-term positioning and growth of Nômade Temple Madrid as a distinctive hospitality and lifestyle destination in Madrid.

**Who we’re looking for**

* An inspiring and commercially minded F\&B leader with a genuine passion for hospitality, gastronomy, and guest experience.
* A strategic thinker who can translate a brand vision into successful and profitable F\&B operations.
* A natural leader capable of inspiring, developing, and empowering diverse teams.
* Strong business acumen and a clear understanding of F\&B financial performance.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* A creative and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and turn ideas into experiences.
* Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to maintain a clear strategic perspective.
* A hands\-on leader who understands that exceptional hospitality is created through both people and operational excellence.
* Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable working in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.

**Requirements**

* Extensive experience in a senior Food \& Beverage leadership position, preferably as F\&B Director, F\&B Manager, or equivalent within luxury hotels, lifestyle hospitality, high\-end restaurants, or multi\-outlet operations.
* Proven experience managing multiple F\&B outlets and complex hospitality operations.
* Strong knowledge of F\&B financial management, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and revenue optimization.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing F\&B concepts and commercial strategies.
* Proven track record of leading, developing, and retaining high\-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of luxury hospitality service standards and guest experience.
* Knowledge of food safety, hygiene, health \& safety, and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Excellent organizational and problem\-solving skills.
* Fluency in Spanish and English.
* Additional languages are a plus.
* Valid EU / Spain work permit.

**Why join us?**


Because at Nômade, hospitality is not just operations, it is emotion, precision, and experience. You will be part of a vibrant environment where people, culture, and creativity come together to create unforgettable moments.

***Equal Opportunity Commitment***

*At Nômade Temple, we are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and respectful environment for all. We ensure equal opportunities in our recruitment process and guarantee fair treatment regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. All hiring decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and alignment with our values.*

In this role, you will provide hands\-on marketing support across planning, campaign delivery, content development, stakeholder coordination and performance reporting. * Supporting the Global Marketing Director and business stakeholders in developing global marketing resources that support retention, new business and brand positioning across strategic growth areas including Future of Energy, Data Centers and Multinational Solutions.
* Assisting with the delivery of integrated marketing campaigns using the full suite of marketing tools and channels, such as digital advertising, account\-based marketing, email campaigns, webinar programmes, collateral material, web content, events and sponsorships.

title: Regional Marketing Manager - Europe
description:
**About Camlin**
Camlin is a global technology leader that operates with the vision of bringing revolutionary products to life for a wide range of industries, including power and rail, and also has interests in a number of R\&D projects in a variety of scientific sectors.  

At Camlin we believe in high quality engineering and design, allowing us to develop market leading products and services. In short, we love creating value for our customers by solving difficult problems. As of now, Camlin operates in over 20 countries worldwide. **Regional Marketing Manager, Europe**

**Department:** Marketing  

**Reports To:** Head of Regional Marketing  

**Travel:** Up to 30%

 **Overview**


Camlin Energy is seeking a commercially focused Regional Marketing Manager to lead marketing execution across Europe. This role is responsible for developing and delivering regional marketing plans that create demand, support strategic account growth, strengthen customer relationships and contribute directly to revenue and pipeline objectives.


Working closely with regional sales teams, product specialists and senior stakeholders, the successful candidate will ensure marketing activity is aligned with priority markets, customer needs and commercial growth targets.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Regional Marketing Strategy \& Execution**

* Develop and execute annual and quarterly marketing plans aligned to regional business objectives.
* Translate global marketing strategies into local market activity.
* Drive integrated campaigns across digital, content, events, ABM and customer engagement programmes.
* Ensure regional marketing activity supports revenue growth, pipeline creation and customer retention.
* Develop regional\-specific messaging frameworks to drive a high\-quality output of marketing materials and thought\-leadership content

**Commercial \& Sales Alignment**

* Partner closely with regional sales leadership and account teams.
* Support strategic account growth through targeted customer engagement programmes.
* Develop marketing initiatives that accelerate opportunities through the sales cycle.
* Create customer\-focused assets that support commercial conversations and account progression.

**Demand Generation**

* Deliver campaigns that generate qualified leads and measurable pipeline impact.
* Work with demand generation and digital specialists to optimise performance across channels.
* Monitor campaign effectiveness and implement continuous improvements.

**Events \& Customer Engagement**

* Lead regional event strategy, including industry exhibitions, executive briefings, webinars and customer forums.
* Maximise event ROI through integrated pre\-event, onsite and post\-event campaigns.
* Build opportunities for customer advocacy and thought leadership.

**Market Intelligence**

* Monitor industry trends, regulatory policies, competitive activity and emerging market opportunities.
* Provide regional insights to support marketing and business planning.
* Identify new growth opportunities within transmission, distribution and critical infrastructure sectors.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work collaboratively with product, sales, engineering and corporate marketing teams.
* Build strong relationships with Siemens Energy marketing counterparts and regional stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment between regional execution and global priorities.

 **Requirements**

**Essential**

* 6\+ years' experience in B2B marketing.
* Strong content writing skills, with the ability to turn technical product information into creative copy for a range of formats
* Experience supporting complex technical or industrial products and services.
* Proven track record delivering integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of demand generation and pipeline development.
* Experience working with sales teams and supporting strategic accounts through account\-based marketing activity.
* Experience within energy, utilities, electrical infrastructure, industrial technology or critical infrastructure sectors.
* Excellent project management and organisational skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of European utility and energy markets.
* Experience operating within a matrix or multinational organisation.
* Additional European language skills.

**Success Measures**

* Contribution to regional pipeline and revenue targets.
* Marketing\-sourced and influenced opportunities.
* Strategic account engagement metrics.
* Campaign performance and ROI.
* Lead\-to\-opportunity conversion performance.
* Growth in customer engagement and brand awareness across priority markets.

 **Our Values*** We work together
* We believe in people
* We won’t accept the ‘way it has always been done’
* We listen to learn
* We’re trying to do the right thing

Individuals seeking employment at Camlin are considered without regards to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital states, ancestry, physical or mental disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

description:

About ContourGlobal
  
  

ContourGlobal, a KKR company, is an established Independent Power Producer (IPP) focused on developing, acquiring, and operating electricity generation and storage assets across Europe, North and South America, with a presence in Africa and Asia. The company currently manages 5\.5 GW of installed capacity across multiple technologies and asset classes, with an additional 800 MW of renewables under construction and nearly 12\.6 GW under development.
  
  

ContourGlobal is accelerating the decarbonization of its portfolio and evolving into a predominantly renewable IPP, supported by long\- term contracts and innovative PPAs coupled with energy management solutions that deliver value beyond market standards. As a symbol of its ongoing transformation and growth, the company recently unveiled a new brand identity, celebrating 20 years of history and embracing The Right Power Forward as its guiding purpose.
  
  

We are recruiting for PLANT MANAGER based in our Orellana CSP plant in Badajoz.
  
  

The candidate will be the maximum responsible for the long – term strategic planning of both Operations and Maintenance activities of the Plant, prioritizing the safety of people and equipment, in order to achieve the maximum performance and availability of the Plant, also supervising compliance with the financial budget of the project, and planning the strategic plans and responding to any Plant problem in a timely manner and in real time, being the guarantor that all this is carried out in an environment of safety and adequate quality, according to existing standards.
  
  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

Organize and coordinate resources, prioritize activities and ensure Plant operation in accordance with Dispatch requirements.
  
Evaluate the current performance of the plant assets, ensuring efficiency, equipment effectiveness, safety, environment, as well as a cost evaluation, monitoring and performance reports (including daily, weekly and monthly reports).
  
Develop an operations strategy to ensure that objectives are achieved.
  
Establishment of “best practices” and effective operations processes, with technical expertise that can be nurtured and shared throughout the company.
  
Provide technical advice and solutions to operations and maintenance teams in the field.
  
Ensure the implementation of company policies and procedures, including operational health and safety protocols.
  
Ensure that the plant operates below its limits for environmental emissions, and the highest international safety standards.
  
Build and manage H\&S teams. This includes finding technically capable candidates, developing training and development goals and plans, as well as evaluating the performance of these employees.
  
Ensure that the processes and procedures of operations, maintenance, safety, environment, and administrative for the business are established and complied with.
  
Develop manuals, reporting tools, training programs and operational plans to ensure that the strategy of operations in CSP plants are consistent within the company's portfolio.
  
Establish a strategic planning for scheduled maintenance inspections (major and minor).
  
Control and monitoring of the financial project, analyse the cost structure and identify areas for improvement of results.
  
Approval of Plant Procedures.
  
Approval of Purchase Orders and associated contracts or commitments with vendors or needed for the plant O\&M.
  
Participate in the process of hiring plant personnel.
  
Act as Head of Emergency Plan, in case of emergency, as defined in the PEI.
  
Coordinate the technical and safety training necessary to improve the professional skills of your team.
  
Be responsible for the effectiveness of the established Management System.
  
Ensure that the policy and objectives are compatible with the context and strategic direction of the organization.
  
Guarantee the integration of the Management System in the business processes.
  
Promote the process and risk\-based approach.
  
Guarantee the necessary resources for the Management System.
  
Communicate the importance of the requirements of the Management System.
  
Guarantee that the Management System achieves the expected results.
  
Engage, direct and support those who contribute to the effectiveness of the Management System.
  
Support other management roles to demonstrate your leadership.
  
Promote continuous improvement.
  
  

ContourGlobal provides equal employment opportunities and maintains a diverse workforce that reflects the rich environment of our society and the markets in which we operate.

title: Fiber Optic Installation Technician - Work Based Learning Program
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

We are hiring Installation Technicians (entry level) for our data center campuses in Spain. No previous data center, IT, telecommunications, or electrical experience is required. We can train you completely from day one.  

  

As an Installation Technician, your job is to install the fiber optic and copper cables that connect new server racks to the network.
  

This is an entry level position within our World Based Learning Program (WBLP). That means you join as a learner and, over 12 months, develop into a fully autonomous technician. During that year you receive structured training, work alongside experienced colleagues, and gradually take on more responsibility.
  

  

Candidates with technical studies or vocational training (electrician, telecommunications, electronics, or similar) will find their background helpful, but it is not a requirement. What is essential is manual dexterity, attention to detail, physical fitness for the demands of the role, and the ability to follow structured technical procedures consistently. English is required, as it will be used to follow internal tools, documentation, and technical procedures.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Physical Requirements:  

This is a physically demanding role performed entirely on\-site in a data center environment. Candidates must be able to:  

  

* Climb ladders and work at heights up to 2 meters regularly
* Lift and carry cable spools and equipment weighing up to 15 kg
* Work overhead with arms raised for extended periods (cable routing)
* Work in a temperature\-controlled environment (15 to 35C) with consistent background noise from server equipment

  

Key Job Responsibilities  

* Prepare, label, and route fiber optic and copper cables following detailed technical work instructions
* Connect cables to network equipment including patch panels, distribution frames, and switches
* Execute connection validation tests using internal software tools to confirm correct signal paths
* Manage cable inventory, monitor stock levels, and maintain organized storage areas
* Coordinate daily with the team regarding task assignments, progress updates, and any blockers
* Adhere to all safety protocols including mandatory use of personal protective equipment and compliance with site access procedures

  

A day in the life  

Your day starts with a quick team stand\-up where your lead assigns positions and reviews priorities. You collect your materials, check your work instructions, and head into the data hall.  

  

Most of your time is hands\-on: routing cables, climbing ladders, making connections, and running validation tests. You track your progress using tools built by your own colleagues, part of a culture where technicians actively contribute to improving how things are done.  

  

This is not a role where you simply follow orders without thinking. We encourage every team member to propose improvements. If you see a process that could be faster, safer, or more efficient, we want to hear it. Several of our current tools and operational procedures were designed by technicians who identified a gap and built the solution. We use AI\-powered platforms to assist with documentation and troubleshooting, and we value people who are curious enough to explore them.  

  

Beyond your core work, you will have opportunities to participate in safety improvement projects, volunteering events, team culture initiatives, and cross\-building rotation to learn new technologies. The environment is dynamic: new network architectures arrive regularly, buildings are constantly expanding, and the team is growing.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* High school or equivalent diploma
* Are 18 years of age or older

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge of computer hardware components and operating systems
* STEM classes or vocational course curriculum education

title: Community & Social Coordinator (Remote)
description:
Percona is looking for someone who can own our technical voice across social and content channels \- someone who reads a MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB changelog for fun, can turn an engineer's Slack message into a post developers actually stop scrolling for, and thinks in terms of a content strategy rather than a content calendar.
   

  

 This role sits inside Engineering, not Marketing. You'll be embedded with the people doing the actual database work, sitting in on the same standups and design discussions, because that's where the content comes from. This isn't an events role, and it isn't a "translate engineering for the business" role either \- it's for someone credible enough to be treated as a peer by engineers, who happens to also own how that work gets told to the world.
   

  

****What You Will Do****
*Social \& Content Strategy (the core of the role)*
* Own the social media strategy end to end: channel priorities, content pillars, voice, cadence, and how success is measured \- not just execution of a plan handed to you.
* Translate real engineering work (patches, RFCs, performance benchmarks, incident postmortems, contributions upstream) into content developers and DBAs actually value. Threads, technical breakdowns, short\-form video, dev.to/blog cross\-posts.
* Build a repeatable system for sourcing content directly from engineering work in flight. Release cycles, RFC discussions, on\-call retros etc. rather than depending on ad hoc asks.
* Use AI\-assisted tools for production (video, drafting, repurposing) without losing technical accuracy or authenticity.
* Define and track the metrics that actually matter for a technical audience (engaged developers, not just impressions) and report on what's working.


*Embedded Technical Credibility*
* Sit close enough to engineering to actually understand what's shipping and why. Attend the relevant standups, sprint reviews, or design discussions as a regular participant, not an occasional observer.
* Be genuinely fluent in open source database engineering conversations. MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB internals, replication, performance tuning, or similar. Enough to interview an engineer, catch a technical inaccuracy, and ask the right follow\-up questions.
* Participate authentically in the communities you're writing for (forums, Slack/Discord, GitHub discussions). This is source material and credibility, not a separate job.
* Push back on engineers' first drafts of an explanation when it's technically sloppy or won't land with the audience, and earn the trust to do that.


*Community Signal, Not Community Ops*
* Monitor community sentiment and conversation on social and community channels to inform what content to make next.
* Amplify contributor and community voices as part of the content strategy.
* Light moderation/engagement on owned channels as needed \- this is in service of content and strategy, not a standalone community\-management function.


 What's Explicitly Out of Scope
   

  

 This role does not own event logistics, on\-site conference representation, swag/booth coordination, or contributor/ambassador program administration. Some occasional travel for content capture (e.g., filming at a conference Percona is already attending) may come up, but travel is not a core expectation.
   

  

****What You Have Done****
* A demonstrated ability to go deep on technical subject matter \- you don't need to ship production code, but you need to understand database/open\-source engineering concepts well enough to write about them accurately, defend that accuracy to an engineer, and be trusted in an engineering room.
* A portfolio or track record of technical content (blog, social, video) aimed at developers or infrastructure/ops audiences.
* Experience owning a social strategy, not just executing one. From channel selection and content planning, to measurement.
* Real, active participation in open source or developer communities.
* Strong short\-form video creation skills, including on\-camera presence.
* Excellent technical writing. Ability to accurately summarize something like a query optimizer change or a replication failure mode for a technical audience.
* Comfortable working directly with engineers as primary sources, day to day, as part of the team rather than a periodic interviewer.


****What Will Make You Stand Out****
* Hands\-on experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB (as a user, DBA, or contributor).
* A history of contributing to open source projects (code, docs, or community).
* Prior experience embedded in or adjacent to an engineering team (DevRel, technical writing, or similar) rather than in a pure marketing/comms function.
* Experience building a technical brand's presence from a smaller base i.e., you've done this from scratch, not just maintained an existing machine.


**Why Percona?**
 At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.
   

  

 Percona is proud to be a remote\-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly\-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.
   

  

 Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work\-from\-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.
   

  

 If you love the idea of working with a high\-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open\-source database space, let’s talk!
   

  

 Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter. We look forward to connecting with you!

title: Head of Growth
description:
**Head of Growth:
   

  

**Company:****
 SimpleStudy is where students go to learn and connect. The Strava for School. The company just closed a $4M seed round, with 1\.5M \+ students across five primary markets: UK, Ireland, Brazil, South Africa, and Australia. Over \~40,000 new students join every week. The team is \~20 people, operating remotely with an office in Lisbon.
   

  

 Notable investors include the first investors in Facebook and Revolut, as well as the founders of Strava and Intercom. The company is lean, product\-obsessed, and deliberately not a typical education company — it's built consumer\-first, with heavy PLG and A/B testing culture. 1 in 4 students in Ireland already use the product, and they want to do that for several hundred million students around the world.
   

  

****Who We're Looking For****
 Whether you're an Ex\-founder, built entire business lines, led teams, or scaled something before that ended in flames. We’re interested in someone who wants to be at the table, leading growth across the business, enabling us to capitalise on the PMF that we’ve found, and exploit the opportunities we’ve already created. SimpleStudy has achieved breakout success in an industry defined by difficulty, and now we’re looking for someone to convert founder\-led PMF into an operationally excellent organisation that can scale. Someone who doesn’t want to be a cog in a machine, but actually put the machine together and steer it.
   

  

****Why Join Us?****
* You’d like to work directly with the company's founders, in a highly trusted role with complete transparency across the company.
* Broken things piss you off, and you want to have the authority to make things that work. Be rewarded for systematisation, have the freedom to fix things where other companies shrug.
* You want to work with amazing people who mutually challenge each other, who want you to be the best version of yourself, professionally and personally.
* You want to work in a venture\-backed startup that is aiming for ludicrous success and an extreme outlier outcome, while building a better world with a platform that helps millions of young people.
* You want to work alongside the leadership team in person in Lisbon—young people who value energy, excellence, creativity, problem\-solving, fitness, and respect.


****What you'll do****
* Work directly with the founder (me) to run half the company, set defaults, and transform it. Where harder problems come up, you point the founder at problems to crack them.
* Own all growth teams and channels across all markets.
* Organise, operationalise, systematise, process, \-wizardise your domains into a highly functional, well\-oiled machine.
* Manage team leads, challenge them, set objectives, create reports and roadmaps, and define goals.
* Think critically about how a multi\-channel, multi\-team growth organisation can be built and run in an AI\-native environment.
* Build a machine that moves fast, clean, and smooth, that knows where it is and why. Where there are easy wins, we chase them and exploit them. Where there’s basics, you make sure we’re already doing them. Where there should be process, you’ve defined them; where there are team roadmaps, you greenlight them. Where there should be hierarchy of focus, you set it. Where you’re doing too much, you know how to get your team’s to step up and can show them the way.


****What You Need****
* Existing understanding of growth pillars and channels in modern software businesses
* Experience in either consumer or multi\-channel marketing\-heavy businesses.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in startup roles with similar skills.
* Proven experience in messy, fast\-moving, early\-stage startup.
* Demonstrable ability to distil complexity and reduce noise into clear steps and systems you’re responsible for running smoothly.
* Exceptional communication and leadership skills that are natural to you.
* Discipline in organisational skills and ensuring it from others.
* Brutally high standards. You have discernment and taste; you know when something is mid and say it.
* Systems thinking for what we are actually doing, why, how, measurement, cadence, who’s accountable, when it is done, repeatably across the org.
* Strong commercial, business\-driven heuristics for decision\-making.
* Intrapersonal skills and experience managing others.


**Details:**
 Top of Market compensation and equity.
   

  

 Compensation Range: $60K \- $130K

title: Director, Product Management
description:
Reporting to the VP, Product for Diligent Market Intelligence, you will lead the strategy, roadmap and evolution of Stewardship Intelligence—one of DMI's core data products. Stewardship Intelligence provides meeting, executive compensation, corporate governance and proxy\-voting intelligence to institutional asset managers, stewardship and governance professionals, compensation advisers and consultants, and corporate issuers.



You will lead both Product Management and Research. This is a domain\-led role: substantial experience in stewardship, proxy voting, corporate governance, executive compensation, investor relations or a closely related capital\-markets domain is required. You will translate customer and market needs into clear product priorities, improve how research is performed at scale, and ensure that Stewardship Intelligence remains trusted, timely and valuable to its users.

* **We care about our people.** Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Job Title: Social Media Marketing Executive/Coordinator

Company: Arabnb Vacation Homes Rental Co. LLC

Department: Marketing

Location: Dubai, UAE (On\-site)

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Reports To: Founder / Managing Director

**About Us**

**ARABNB Holiday Homes**

Arabnb is a luxury vacation homes company operating across Dubai. We manage AED 100M\+ in high\-value real estate assets, including premium apartments and villas in Dubai’s topperforming prime districts. Every Arabnb residence features elevated amenities — fully equipped kitchens, premium linens, fast WiFi, smart home comforts, private balconies, community pools, and dedicated workspaces. From concierge services to seamless property management, we redefine what luxury short\-stay living looks like in Dubai.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, driven, and resourceful Social Media Marketing Executive to join us in\-house in Dubai. This person will take full ownership of the social media presence for both Arabnb Holiday Homes across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn. You will be the voice and visual identity of both brands online — planning, creating, filming, editing, and publishing content on a daily basis. You will also manage the Founder’s personal LinkedIn profile, building thought leadership in the hospitality and real estate space. Being based on\-site in Dubai is essential. The role requires frequent content filming at our vacation home properties, development sites, and around Dubai, as well as real\-time posting and close collaboration with the team. This is not a remote or hybrid position.

**Key Responsibilities**

Arabnb Holiday Homes — Vacation Homes \& Hospitality · Create and execute a social media content calendar for Arabnb across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, showcasing our luxury vacation home portfolio.

· Film and edit high\-quality property walkthrough videos, guest experience content, Reels, TikToks, and Stories that highlight the lifestyle and amenities of each Arabnb property.

· Develop content themes around Dubai tourism, luxury short\-stay living, guest testimonials, property reveals, and seasonal promotions.

· Write compelling captions and copy that speak to potential guests, property owners, and investors, tailored to each platform.

· Engage with the Arabnb community — respond to DMs, comments, and inquiries promptly to drive bookings and build brand loyalty.

· Build and execute a direct booking strategy to reduce reliance on OTAs (Airbnb, Booking.com, etc.) and drive guests to book directly through the Arabnb website.

· Set up and manage retargeting campaigns via Meta Business Suite to re\-engage previous guests and website visitors, encouraging repeat stays and direct bookings.

· Implement and manage basic SEO for the Arabnb website — optimise property listing pages, blog content, meta descriptions, and keywords to increase organic search visibility and drive traffic.

· Create and drive traffic to dedicated landing pages, seasonal offers, and promotional campaigns designed to convert website visitors into direct bookings.

· Develop and manage a customer loyalty program to incentivise repeat guests — including referral rewards, returning guest discounts, exclusive offers, and email\-based re\-engagement campaigns.

· Work on email marketing flows (welcome sequences, post\-stay follow\-ups, special offers) to nurture past guests and encourage direct re\-bookings.

· Track and report on Arabnb social media performance metrics (reach, engagement, follower growth, booking enquiries, website traffic, direct booking conversions) and provide actionable insights.

· Plan, set up, run, and optimise paid advertising campaigns through Meta Business Suite (Facebook \& Instagram Ads), including audience targeting, A/B testing, budget management, and performance reporting.

· Set up and manage TikTok Ads campaigns when required.

· Design graphics, carousels, thumbnails, and marketing creatives using Canva and other design tools for both brands.

· Monitor social media trends, competitor activity, and platform algorithm changes to keep both brands ahead of the curve.

· Coordinate and plan content shoots, including scheduling, location scouting, and directing talent on camera.

· Manage influencer outreach and coordinate collaborations relevant to either brand.

· Provide weekly/monthly performance reports with data\-driven recommendations.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

· Experience: 1–2 years of hands\-on experience in social media marketing, content creation, or a similar digital marketing role. Experience in real estate, hospitality, or luxury lifestyle brands is a strong plus.

· Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory if experience is strong).

· Video Editing: Proficient in video editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, InShot, or similar tools. Must be able to produce polished, professional video content independently — from filming to final edit.

· Design Skills: Strong working knowledge of Canva for creating social media graphics, Stories templates, presentation decks, and marketing collateral.

· Meta Business Suite: Hands\-on experience with Meta Business Suite is essential. Must know how to set up, run, and optimise paid ad campaigns on Facebook and Instagram, including audience targeting, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, retargeting, A/B testing, and budget management. Ability to read and act on ad performance data is a must.

· Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn — including best practices, algorithms, content formats, and native analytics tools.

· Copywriting: Excellent written English with the ability to craft engaging captions, CTAs, and copy for different audiences — from luxury hospitality guests to real estate investors and brokers.

· Creativity: A strong creative eye with the ability to conceptualise and execute original content ideas that drive engagement, build brand awareness, and generate leads.

· SEO \& Website Traffic: Basic to intermediate understanding of SEO principles — keyword research, on\-page optimisation, meta tags, and content strategy to drive organic traffic to the Arabnb website and increase direct bookings.

· Analytics: Comfortable using Meta Business Suite, TikTok Analytics, LinkedIn Analytics, Instagram Insights, and Google Analytics to measure performance, track website traffic, and inform strategy.

· Email Marketing: Familiarity with email marketing platforms (e.g., Mailchimp, Brevo) for building guest re\-engagement flows, loyalty campaigns, and promotional newsletters.

· Location: Must be based in Dubai, UAE and available to work on\-site full\-time. This is not a remote or hybrid position.

**Nice to Have**

· Experience running TikTok Ads campaigns.

· Experience with scheduling tools such as Later, Hootsuite, Buffer, or Metricool.

· Photography skills and comfort being on camera or directing others on camera.

· Familiarity with CRM tools or lead capture workflows.

· Experience in Dubai’s real estate or holiday home/hospitality industry.

· Experience with Google Ads or Google Hotel Ads for driving direct bookings.

· Familiarity with loyalty program tools or platforms (e.g., Stamp Me, LoyaltyLion).

· Understanding of OTA dynamics (Airbnb, Booking.com) and strategies to drive direct bookings away from third\-party platforms.

**What We Offer**

· Competitive monthly salary of AED 5,000 – 6,000 (based on experience and skills).

· Opportunity to take full ownership of the social media presence for two growing Dubai brands — in luxury hospitality.

· A dynamic, fast\-paced work environment with room for creativity, ownership, and career growth.

· Direct mentorship and collaboration with the Founder.

· Exposure to vacation rental industries in one of the world’s most exciting property markets.

· Visa sponsorship (if applicable).

· Annual leave and public holidays as per UAE Labour Law.

**How to Apply Interested candidates should submit the following:**

· Updated CV/Resume.

· Portfolio or links to social media accounts you have managed (especially in real estate, hospitality, or lifestyle sectors).

· Examples of paid ad campaigns you have run on Meta Business Suite, including results if available.

· A short cover letter explaining why you are the right fit for this role.

Pay: AED5,000\.00 \- AED6,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

 Harley\-Davidson Motor Company, founded in a humble Milwaukee backyard shed in 1903, still calls the city home. Today, its Corporate Campus includes a 4\.8\-acre public park—a welcoming greenspace open to all. Join our team as a Director Brand Marketing.

description:
**About CookUnity**
 Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first\-of\-its\-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready\-to\-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.
   

  

 Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever\-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission:
 **empower Chefs to nourish the world.**
 If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At CookUnity, the Brand Marketing team is responsible for developing and executing world\-class marketing activations and experiences that drive brand awareness and earn loyalty beyond reason. This team sets the vision and strategy for the brand and brings it to life with strategic rigor, creative excellence, and cultural relevance. Through insight\-inspired, data\-informed brand storytelling and experiences, CookUnity’s Brand Marketing team will build a category\-defining brand loved by an entire generation of foodies.
   

  

**The Role**
 CookUnity is seeking a seasoned brand design manager to take our creative function to the next level — elevating design craft, modernizing design operations, and boldly differentiating the CookUnity brand. In this role you will oversee the development and expression of the brand visual identity across all consumer touch points, both online and offline, while managing and actively leveling up a team of talented, ambitious designers.
   

  

 Through your leadership and vision, you will build and scale a world\-class brand design function with customer obsession and creative excellence at its core. The ideal candidate brings not only a mastery of design craft honed at best\-in\-class consumer brands, but also the operational rigor to implement new standards of design process and team performance — and the forward\-thinking mindset to leverage AI tools as a high\-impact lever for quality and efficiency.
   

  

 This is a role for a leader who sets the bar high, builds the systems to meet it, and brings a team along for the journey. Reporting to the VP of Brand Marketing, this role is uniquely positioned to create an impact that helps CookUnity resonate emotionally and grow commercially in unprecedented ways.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Creative Vision \& Brand Stewardship**
* Develop and evangelize an inspiring creative vision for the future of CookUnity and help the organization make progress towards achieving its full potential
* Lead the Brand Design team to bring the essence of CookUnity to life through a differentiated design system and visual storytelling across website, app, social media, advertising, CRM, and a growing ecosystem of packaging
* Own, refine, and continue to build on the CookUnity brand identity and visual system as a living resource that evolves with new learnings and insights to better support the needs of the customer and company
* Bring the standards and instincts of best\-in\-class consumer brands to CookUnity — championing unwavering expectations for design craft, quality, and executional consistency


**Design Process \& Operational Excellence**
* Design and manage an ambitious, end\-to\-end creative process — including intake, internal creative reviews, stakeholder feedback cycles, and approval workflows — that ensures consistently on\-time delivery of high\-quality assets
* Lead regular creative reviews of all ongoing design work to provide timely feedback and coaching, and ensure pixel\-perfect execution across all design deliverables
* Lead the routing, feedback, and approval process for brand design deliverables to executive staff and Founder as needed for high\-visibility, high\-impact initiatives


**AI Integration \& Design Innovation**
* Champion the integration of AI\-based tools into the team's design workflows, identifying high\-impact opportunities to automate repeatable tasks, accelerate production, and free the team to focus on higher\-order creative work
* Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and serve as an internal resource for best practices, responsible use, and practical application within a brand design context
* Foster a team culture that embraces experimentation with emerging tools while maintaining the quality standards and creative integrity the brand demands


**Team Leadership \& Talent Development**
* Mentor and motivate a small but mighty team of talented designers, actively leveling up individual skills through structured feedback, coaching, and growth\-oriented development conversations
* Build a culture of trust, openness, accountability, and a relentless pursuit of design excellence — where high standards are a shared value, not just a directive
* Lead by doing: maintain mastery of the tools the team uses daily (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Claude Design, and relevant AI design tools) and be willing to roll up your sleeves alongside the team when needed


**Cross\-Functional Partnership**
* Partner with teammates, peers, and key stakeholders to proactively identify opportunities or challenges, and take a leadership role in bringing tangible design solutions forward
* Partner directly with brand copy team to define visual storytelling approach, ensuring consistency and deep integration between these teams to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of all creative output
* Assume a strong company presence as an internal standard\-bearer of category\-defining creativity, building trust, alignment, and influence across the organization
* Bring principles of design thinking, a solution\-oriented mindset, and an entrepreneurial spirit to achieving impactful results without depending on significant resources


**Minimum Requirements**
* 8\+ years experience in brand design; experience in top consumer brands and/or agencies is a plus
* 4\+ years managing other designers
* A respected brand design leader with a track record of shipping excellent work and a portfolio demonstrating a mastery of design craft across multiple disciplines of design
* Proficiency in video and how to leverage design in this format is a plus
* Passion for insights and performance data in shaping creative work and a commitment to building a culture that embraces these essential inputs
* Experience operating in a fast\-paced growth environment, including dealing with ambiguity, shifting priorities \& rapid iteration
* Very detail oriented, well organized, and a proven ability to effectively manage multiple projects, work streams, or initiatives simultaneously
* Highly collaborative in nature with ability to partner across various functions throughout a company and demonstrate flexible decision\-making based on new insight or feedback
* A genuine passion for design and a love of the creative process
* Proficiency in English at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field is a plus


**Learn More About CookUnity**
 We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.
   

  

 We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!
   

  

**Benefits**
 💸 Get paid in USD
   

  

 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.
   

  

 ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date.
   

  

 🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.
   

  

 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3\-5 days each time the need arises.
   

  

 🐣 Family leave of 12 weeks for primary caregiver and 6 weeks for secondary caregiver, fully paid.
   

  

 🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more.
   

  

 🤖 AI\-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.
   

  

 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you.

title: Executive Producer, Regional Products
description:
****JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**
**Executive Producer, Regional Products****
**About MBN**
 Middle East Broadcasting Networks (MBN) is the premier Arabic\-first media organization that connects the Middle East and the United States. The company is in the midst of an exciting digital transformation and looking for energetic and talented people who care about journalism and the Middle East to join us on this journey.
   

  

 We provide original and indispensable reporting, perspectives and commentary on the Middle East and how America’s engagement impacts the region. MBN delivers content in both Arabic and English across multiple platforms, in formats including written articles, short\-form video, newsletters, podcasts, data trackers and social media.
   

  

 Our target audience is decision\-makers, influencers, and residents of key capitals across the Middle East, as well as the next generation of globally engaged, digitally connected youth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The
 **Executive Producer, Regional Products** 
 oversees the conceptualization, daily production, editorial direction, and multiplatform delivery of MBN’s original shows, video series, and narrative podcasts produced across the MENA region.
   

  

 Working directly with the Editor\-in\-Chief, this role directs production pipelines across key regional hubs—including Beirut, Amman, Baghdad, Cairo, Dubai, and beyond. The Executive Producer ensures that regional productions meet rigorous journalistic standards while being engineered from the ground up for digital performance, YouTube distribution, and emerging platforms.
   

  

 Ø The ideal candidate possesses deep editorial judgment, hands\-on technical proficiency across video and audio workflows, and a proven ability to lead and coach distributed teams of hosts, producers, writers, and editors across multiple Arab capitals.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
 The following tasks are considered essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions:
   

  

**Editorial Direction and Program Development**
 Ø Partner with the Editor\-in\-Chief to conceptualize, commission, and launch original regional shows, video franchises, and podcasts that align with MBN’s mission and content strategy.
   

  

 Ø Set and maintain the daily and long\-term editorial direction for all regional non\-news programming, ensuring nuanced, balanced, and fact\-checked coverage.
   

  

 Ø Study the MENA media landscape and competitor output systematically to identify content gaps, audience trends, and format opportunities.
   

  

 Ø Develop show and podcast concepts tailored specifically for target demographics in key Arab capitals as well as the digital youth audience.
   

  

**Cross\-Bureau Production Management and Delivery**
 Ø Direct day\-to\-day operations and production schedules across distributed teams in Beirut, Amman, Baghdad, Cairo, Dubai, and other field locations.
   

  

 Ø Enforce strict production deadlines to ensure reliable, on\-time delivery of daily and weekly show episodes, podcast installments, and recurring video packages.
   

  

 Ø Supervise the complete production pipeline: pitching, research, pre\-interviews, rundown construction, scripting, studio tapings, remote shoots, editing, and final sign\-off.
   

  

 Ø Conduct regular production meetings, set clear daily deliverables, and provide structured operational and editorial reports to executive leadership.
   

  

**Digital Strategy, Packaging, and Distribution**
 Ø Architect full\-episode structures alongside digital\-first cutdowns, segmentations, and short\-form promotional clips tailored for YouTube, vertical video platforms, and social channels.
   

  

 Ø Optimize all regional video and audio assets for discovery: title development, custom thumbnail strategies, retention hooks, pacing, and platform\-specific metadata.
   

  

 Ø Explore, test, and operationalize content distribution across new and emerging digital platforms, streaming outlets, and podcast networks to expand regional reach and engagement.
   

  

**Talent Management and Coaching**
 Ø Scout, recruit, and train on\-air hosts, podcast talent, writers, producers, video editors, and sound designers across bureaus.
   

  

 Ø Provide direct editorial and technical coaching to hosts and contributors, refining interview styles, delivery, and adherence to appropriate Arabic\-language registers.
   

  

 Ø Train video editors and field producers on pacing, visual structure, script compression, and multiplatform storytelling standards.
   

  

**Technical Oversight and Innovation**
