We are looking for a hands\-on Design Director to join our US team in a permanent, remote\-first role based in Southern California. You will work primarily from home and be available to travel to client sites across the United States as engagements require. You will lead complex digital\-product and design\-system engagements across our portfolio, including work in regulated industries and global medical technology. AI will be a core part of how you explore, prototype, make decisions, and help teams deliver better work.  

This is a senior client\-facing role for someone who is excited by how AI is changing design and product development. You will set direction, stay close to the work, and help clients move from isolated experiments to useful AI\-enabled products, workflows, and operating models. You will combine curiosity and speed with strong judgment about where human craft, review, and accountability matter.

#### **Your Tasks**

* Lead client engagements end\-to\-end, from initial framing and design direction through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Translate user needs, business goals, brand intent, accessibility, engineering, content, and compliance requirements into clear product and system direction.
* Own the design quality of the work, balancing strategic clarity with strong visual, interaction, and systems\-design craft.
* Direct the creation and evolution of scalable Figma libraries, component architectures, variables, tokens, themes, patterns, prototypes, and documentation.
* Work closely with product and engineering leaders to connect design decisions with production code, release processes, and measurable product outcomes.
* Establish practical governance and contribution models that support distributed teams without overloading a small central group.
* Facilitate workshops and decision\-making with senior stakeholders across design, product, engineering, research, content, and compliance.
* Guide multidisciplinary teams, coach designers, set a high bar for craft, and give clear, constructive direction.
* Make AI part of the design practice every day, using it for research synthesis, ideation, content, prototyping, design\-system work, and design\-to\-code exploration.
* Prototype AI\-enabled product experiences, including conversational, adaptive, generative, and agentic interactions, then test whether they create meaningful value for people.
* Experiment quickly with new tools and models, share what works, and help the team build repeatable AI workflows instead of one\-off demos.
* Evaluate AI output critically and establish practical guardrails for quality, accessibility, privacy, approved source material, human review, and accountability.
* Help shape Edenspiekermann's AI\-enabled product and design\-systems practice, contributing to how we pitch, deliver, and talk about the work.
#### **Your profile**

* You have at least 8 years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or design systems, including several years leading complex client or enterprise engagements.
* Your portfolio demonstrates systems thinking, refined visual craft, shipped digital products, and credible AI\-enabled work.
* You have led design systems across multiple products, platforms, brands, or teams and understand how they connect to Figma libraries, production code, documentation, versioning, and engineering adoption.
* You have experience in a regulated or high\-accountability environment and treat accessibility as a system requirement.
* You can lead senior client conversations, facilitate difficult decisions, and turn ambiguity into a practical path forward with curiosity, judgment, and a collaborative, low\-ego attitude.
* You actively use generative and agentic AI in your own practice, can demonstrate workflows beyond surface\-level prompting, and can separate useful applications from hype.
* You communicate fluently in English and are comfortable collaborating across US and European teams.
* You are based in Southern California, willing and able to travel to client sites across the United States as engagements require, and legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
#### **We Offer**

* A permanent, full\-time, remote\-first role with a central place in our US design team.
* The annual salary range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
* A defined contribution toward medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus access to a healthcare FSA.
* A 401(k) plan with a 2% company match and eligibility for a discretionary year\-end bonus based on company performance.
* A flexible PTO policy, with time off coordinated around client and team commitments, plus eleven paid holidays, a year\-end office closure, monthly internet and wellness stipends, and professional\-development support.
* The opportunity to lead visible, strategically important product, design\-system, and AI\-enabled transformation engagements.
* An international portfolio and regular collaboration with colleagues across Europe and the United States.
* A high\-craft, low\-ego team with direct access to partners and senior leadership, real autonomy, constructive feedback, and space to shape how we work.
* A multidisciplinary team that is actively building AI into design, strategy, research, engineering, and delivery.
#### **We are pleased to meet you!**


We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/beliefs, disability, age, and sexual orientation and identity.

**If you are interested, please provide us with the following documents and information:**

* Current CV
* Portfolio with at least one substantial product or design\-system case and a credible AI\-enabled product or workflow example
* A short explanation of your role, decisions, measurable contribution, and how AI changed the work or outcome
* Earliest possible start date


One more thing, never fear to apply initiative. We understand: a lack of confidence can sometimes keep us from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as the perfect applicant. That's why we encourage you to apply to us.

description:
Growth\-minded, business leader committed to driving team success and brand value.


### **About Noble West**


Love food, wine and agriculture? Ready to work hard with a fantastic group of mission\-driven professionals? If yes to the above we would love to hear from you! We are currently looking for team members based in the Sacramento, Los Angeles and Boise, ID communities.
### **Description**


**About Noble West**


Noble West is an agency built for the future of food. We’re a fast\-growing, ag and food\-focused collective of changemakers with an incredible roster of clients. We will change the way consumers view and value food, and conversely, how farmers view consumers. Our unrivaled access to food sources is a primary differentiator.

 **About the Role**


Our independent, woman\-owned agency seeks an **Account Director** to lead key client relationships, agency profitability and team development. This leader will play a vital role in driving strategic direction, ensuring excellence across deliverables and fostering growth for the agency and for our clients.

 **Our Values**


The ideal candidate will embody Noble West’s core values:

* *Putting People First*: Build relationships grounded in respect and empathy.
* *Audacity*: Boldly explore innovative ideas and challenges.
* *Never Settle*: Strive for continuous improvement and push beyond “good enough.”
* *Doing the Right Thing*: Prioritize decisions that benefit the greater good.

 **Location \& Reporting**


This is a 100% remote position, but not virtual. For collaboration and bonding, candidates should be located in or near: Boise, ID; Sacramento or Los Angeles, CA.

  

The **Account Director** serves as the senior business and strategic lead across assigned accounts, owning client relationships, revenue performance and overall portfolio direction. This role guides integrated campaigns from brief through execution, manages growth and renewals, and mentors junior team members in a small, fast\-paced agency environment. The position reports to the Group Account Director.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the senior strategic lead across accounts, primary contact for client partners at all levels — including senior stakeholders — and build strong, personal relationships.
* Lead annual planning for assigned clients, campaign planning and quarterly business reviews, translating client business objectives into clear strategic direction.
* Develop scopes of work, budgets and renewal proposals, ensuring alignment between deliverables, staffing and financial targets.
* Own revenue forecasting and margin performance across assigned accounts, proactively identifying and managing scope changes.
* Guide development of integrated strategies and creative briefs in collaboration with internal teams across paid, owned and earned channels.
* Present strategic recommendations and creative work confidently, ensuring rationale is clear, differentiated and grounded in business objectives.
* Oversee execution across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring timelines, quality standards and client expectations are met.
* Directly manage and mentor Account Supervisors and Account Executives, setting clear expectations for performance, financial accountability and growth.
* Partner with Operations, Content \& Connections and Creative leadership to align resources, anticipate risks and resolve challenges efficiently.
* Identify and secure organic growth opportunities within existing accounts, supporting renewal and financial expansion conversations.

 **Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Experience**: **6–9 years** of agency experience managing integrated accounts
* **Leadership**: Strong, motivational leadership style that inspires cross\-functional teams and clients alike.
* **Vision**: Exceptional ability to balance creative ambition with strategic business priorities.
* **Brand Strategy**: Experience with cultivating/contributing to the development of brand and communications strategy.
* **Relationship Building**: Proven track record of cultivating deep Director \& VP client partnerships and growing global accounts.
* **Financial Acumen**: Experience managing account budgets, P\&Ls, and identifying growth opportunities.
* **Integrated Expertise**: Knowledge of media, production, and creative development, with a passion for food and agriculture.
* **Communication**: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present ideas effectively to internal and external audiences.
* **Problem Solving**: Calmly navigate challenges and find solutions in fast\-paced, dynamic environments.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Skilled in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Slack; familiarity with project management tools is a plus.Working knowledge of AI tools and Google Analytics.

 **Why Join Noble West?**


At Noble West, you’ll lead exciting work at the intersection of creativity, agriculture, food, sustainability and innovation. You’ll be part of a collaborative team that values bold ideas, respects individuals, and strives to make a difference in the future of food. If you’re a driven leader passionate about food, agriculture, sustainability and building exceptional client relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

 *Noble West is committed to fair pay practices. When preparing an offer, we consider the candidate's resume, experience, interview feedback, internal equity and cost of living for the remote location. The projected annual salary for this position is $95,000\-$115,000\. Candidates must live in or be willing to relocate to Idaho or California. Benefits include agency\-paid medical, dental, vision, life, 401 (k) plan with a match, option for quarterly gross profit sharing bonus, birthday days off, performance growth planning and great mission\-forward clients!*

  


#### **Salary**


$95,000 \- $115,000 per year

title: Line Artist
description:
**GREAT ART. IT'S KINDA WHAT WE DO HERE \& WHAT WE'RE PASSIONATE ABOUT. GREAT ART \+ GREAT GARMENT \= GREAT DAY.**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**


Altered Latitudes is a resort\-driven performance apparel brand creating visually striking artwork for coastal, lake, mountain, park, and lifestyle destinations. We specialize in sublimation and elevated screenprint graphics built for performance garments and technical applications. Our work captures a sense of place and experience while delivering fresh, modern, highly wearable product that stands out at retail.


We are seeking a highly creative Apparel Graphic Designer, internally known as a Line Artist, to develop original, trend\-forward graphics with a strong emphasis on sublimation and supporting screenprint design. This role goes beyond making graphics. It creates product stories that translate across garments, territories, and markets. Working closely with the Altered Latitudes Creative Director, this designer will build cohesive, scalable art programs that feel unmistakably on\-brand and ready for real\-world wear.

**PAY \+ SCHEDULE**

**Schedule:** Monday through Friday, full\-time days. 8:00am to 5:00pm

**Location:** Remote or onsite in Detroit Lakes, Minnesota. Remote applicants may be considered if they reside in AZ, CA, CO, IA, IL, ID, FL, MN, MO, NC, ND, NV, PA, SD, VA, WI, or WY.

**Pay: $50,000 to $60,000**

**Growth:** This role helps shape the next chapter of Altered Latitudes by expanding destination\-driven performance artwork into new markets, garments, and consumer experiences.


Remote work requirements: Cable, DSL, or fiber internet with at least 100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, with no service degradation during work. Two monitors are required. Chromebooks are not compatible. Internet and workspace must reliably support large\-file uploads, downloads, collaboration, and secure access to company systems.

**BENEFITS**


Lakeshirts \| Blue 84 offers an employee benefits package for eligible team members. Current plan details, eligibility requirements, and enrollment information will be provided during the hiring process.

**A TYPICAL DAY \| CONCEPT \+ CREATE \+ REFINE \+ ELEVATE**

* Develop original artwork and apparel graphics for performance, resort, outdoor, and lifestyle collections, with a primary focus on sublimation.
* Create visually exciting, trend\-forward concepts rooted in destination, place, and experience.
* Translate creative direction into cohesive, scalable art programs across markets, territories, garment types, and placements.
* Design with performance fabrics, technical apparel, production methods, color behavior, and real\-world wearability in mind.
* Create elevated screenprint graphics and adapt concepts across sublimation and screenprint applications when appropriate.
* Manage multiple line art and custom art projects while meeting deadlines and prioritizing a steady flow of incoming work.
* Deliver artwork that meets customer specifications while staying aligned with Altered Latitudes brand and resort\-market guidelines.
* Research fashion, color, illustration, typography, outdoor, travel, and graphic trends to keep collections innovative and market\-relevant.
* Maintain ongoing awareness of the resort and destination retail market, including coastal, lake, mountain, park, and lifestyle categories.
* Present, discuss, refine, and elevate work in partnership with the Creative Director and cross\-functional teammates.
* Attend scheduled meetings and contribute to other responsibilities as assigned, living our value of Team.

**SKILLS \| ADOBE ILLUSTRATOR \+ SUBLIMATION THINKING \+ APPAREL AWARENESS \+ CREATIVE EXECUTION**

* Four or more years of graphic design experience in apparel, performance product, resort, outdoor, or lifestyle categories preferred.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating original apparel graphics, destination\-driven storytelling, trend\-forward design, and retail\-ready product thinking.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop required.
* Strong understanding of sublimation artwork development, including color, scale, placement, performance fabric considerations, and technical production requirements.
* Experience creating graphics specifically for performance fabrics and technical apparel preferred.
* Working knowledge of screenprint production and garment decoration, secondary to sublimation expertise.
* Strong typography, composition, color, illustration, and visual storytelling skills.
* Excellent organization and ability to manage multiple creative projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Clear communication skills, openness to feedback, and a collaborative, team\-first mindset.
* Self\-starter who is nimble, adaptable, and energized by a fast\-moving creative environment and evolving trends.

**WHY LAKESHIRTS IS THE PLACE YOU WANT TO BE**


OUR CULTURE is one\-of\-a\-kind and truly sets us apart. We are proud of our humble beginnings and non\-corporate style. We offer a unique atmosphere, unlike any other manufacturer. We work hard to be the best and we seek only committed individuals that will help move our company forward and embrace our values and culture. Lakeshirts \| Blue 84 is one of the largest privately owned screenprint manufacturers in the United States, responsible for decorating and distribution of a wide variety of garments for the resort, college and K\-12 markets. At our headquarters in Detroit Lakes, MN, we employ over 1000 great people, proudly producing 35,000\+ garments daily. It's not just a job but a lifestyle. Our job descriptions help support and guide you in the role you play in making our company successful. LIFE'S BETTER IN A T\-SHIRT. IT REALLY IS.


ALTERED LATITUDES was founded in 2011 in Charleston, South Carolina as a coastal\-inspired performance apparel brand focused on premium sun protection garments and elevated artwork built for life outdoors. The brand has grown beyond the shoreline into destinations shaped by adventure, from coastal escapes and lake weekends to mountain towns, parks, and outdoor recreation. Since joining the Lakeshirts \| Blue 84 family in 2026, Altered Latitudes has continued to expand its performance garments and destination\-driven design philosophy into new markets and consumer experiences.

**COGNITIVE OR MENTAL REQUIREMENTS OF THE JOB**


Employee must be able to see and hear, read and write. Requires good judgment and a people\-oriented, flexible, organized, diplomatic, reliable, enthusiastic, courteous, helpful, and patient approach.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

**CONTINUOUSLY:** Sit; reach below shoulder height.

**FREQUENTLY:** Walk; reach at shoulder height.

**OCCASIONALLY:** Lift; stand; carry; lift under 10 lbs.; carry under 10 lbs.; reach above shoulder height.

**NEVER:** Push; pull; climb; balance; bend; twist; crawl; reach; lift 10\-24 lbs.; lift 25\-50 lbs.; lift over 50 lbs.; carry 10\-24 lbs.; carry 25\-50 lbs.; carry over 50 lbs.

**NOTE / DISCLAIMER**


This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive and should in no way be considered a contract or guarantee of employment. Employee may perform other related duties as needed based on the ongoing needs of the business. Employment is at will where permitted by applicable law and implies no specific length of employment.

title: Executive Director of Operations
description:
Executive Director, Oregon Afterschool and Summer for Kids Network

(OregonASK)

Professional Learning and Systems Improvement for Afterschool and Summer Programs

About OregonASK

Founded in 2005, OregonASK is a collaboration of public and private organizations and community members that seeks to address common issues and concerns across all expanded learning areas, including childcare, content specialists, recreation, education, and youth development. The mission of OregonASK is to support, expand, and educate on quality expanded learning opportunities for children, youth, and families throughout Oregon.

The organization envisions an Oregon in which all children, youth, and families have access to quality expanded learning opportunities within their communities; in which all services enhance the positive development and future opportunities of children while keeping them safe from harm; and in which all programs, services, and activities are of high quality and contribute to strong communities and schools.

OregonASK pursues this mission through three areas of work: partnership, policy, and professional development. The organization connects providers with government agencies, businesses, and other nonprofit organizations across the state; works directly with providers, public administrators, and elected officials to shape policy affecting afterschool and summer programs; and provides training to hundreds of professionals each year through statewide conferences and instruction delivered to individual programs. Accomplishments since its founding include creating the first database of afterschool programs in Oregon, developing Quality Standards, Competencies, and Outcomes for the field, supporting Oregon's 21st Century Community Learning Centers programs, and preparing reports for legislators and policymakers on the issues facing afterschool programs in the state.

Why this role matters now? As OASK’s long\-time Executive Director retires, the organization is at an important turning point and ready for new leadership to build on its history and guide its future. At a time when afterschool and summer programs are essential, OASK is looking for an Executive Director who can provide steady leadership, strengthen fund development, and bring policy experience that helps advance the organization’s mission and long\-term impact.

The next Executive Director will lead OASK through its next chapter of organizational development, mission impact, and relationship\-building. This person will partner with the board, lead staff and operations, steward financial sustainability, and represent the organization with credibility and care.

This role is well suited for a leader who can balance strategy and execution, strengthen systems and culture, and build trust across stakeholders. Executive search materials commonly work best when they combine the mission case, organizational context, and the specific leadership opportunity in one concise narrative.

Position Summary

The Executive Director provides strategic leadership for statewide initiatives that strengthen Oregon's system of afterschool, summer, and other expanded learning opportunities, referred to throughout this description as out of school time programs. The position directs professional learning, quality improvement, partnership development, policy engagement, and research and evaluation in support of programs that are equitable and of high quality.

This is a leadership and oversight position. The Executive Director establishes direction, secures resources, and ensures quality across this body of work, guiding network staff, contracted trainers, consultants, and partners who carry out the daily work of training, coaching, and technical assistance.

The Executive Director works with federal, state, and Tribal governments; philanthropic and foundation partners; education partners; community organizations; and program providers to advance workforce development, continuous improvement, systems alignment, and equitable access to quality learning opportunities. All work is grounded in equity, cultural responsiveness, and practice that engages communities directly, with particular attention to communities that have been historically underserved, including Tribal, rural, immigrant and refugee, and culturally specific communities.

Role Scope and First Year Priorities

The Executive Director provides statewide leadership for the professional learning, quality improvement, partnership, and systems change work of OregonASK. In the first year, priorities include strengthening relationships with program providers, Tribal communities, state agencies, and education partners; assessing workforce and professional learning needs; advancing a coordinated quality improvement strategy; and establishing clear measures for participation, reach, satisfaction, and program impact.

Performance in the first year will be assessed against measures such as the following:

* Participation and reach: the number of professionals, programs, and communities engaged in professional learning and technical assistance, with attention to regional and rural distribution.
* Satisfaction and relevance: participant feedback on trainings, coaching, convenings, and resources.
* Program quality and impact: measurable movement on quality improvement indicators among participating programs.
* Partnership health: active agreements and sustained engagement with state agencies, Tribal partners, education partners, funders, and provider organizations.
* Resource development: proposals submitted, funds secured or renewed, and funder relationships stewarded in support of network priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Partnerships, Systems, and Policy

* Lead partnerships across sectors, statewide initiatives, and policy engagement that strengthen Oregon's out of school time system and advance shared priorities.
* Convene and represent OregonASK with federal, state, and Tribal governments; education partners; community organizations; funders; and statewide and national networks.
* Advance alignment across agencies, funding streams, and initiatives so that program providers experience a coordinated and coherent set of supports. Research, Data, and Evaluation
* Oversee research, data collection, evaluation, and analysis to inform strategy, continuous improvement, and workforce development.
* Translate data and evaluation findings into reports, recommendations, presentations, and improvements to professional learning, technical assistance, and statewide initiatives.
* Interpret results and construct clear and compelling narratives that communicate the impact of Oregon's afterschool and summer programs to providers, funders, policymakers, and the public. Professional Learning, Technical Assistance, and Quality Improvement
* Direct a statewide professional learning and quality improvement system for school\-age program professionals and programs, encompassing workforce needs assessment, training, coaching, technical assistance, and continuous improvement, delivered through network staff, contracted trainers, and partners.
* Establish the strategy, calendar, and quality expectations for conferences, regional trainings, and learning communities, ensuring alignment with the Oregon Quality Standards for Afterschool and Summer Programs and, where applicable, the Oregon Registry (ORO) and Core KnowledgeCategories (CKCs).
* Guide network staff in providing coaching and technical assistance that supports organizational development, staffing, onboarding, evaluation, and program quality.
* Oversee the development of training, tools, resources, and assessment processes addressing youth development, trauma\-informed practice, inclusion, behavior support, science and technology education, program management, and staff supervision.
* Convene quality improvement committees and learning communities and apply evaluation findings to strengthen statewide initiatives. Resource Development and Organizational Sustainability
* Lead or support grant strategy, proposal development, funder stewardship, and resource development to sustain and expand the work of OregonASK.
* Build and maintain relationships with funders and partners and develop compelling proposals that align organizational priorities with available funding opportunities.
* Steward awarded funds in coordination with organizational leadership, including reporting, compliance, and budget monitoring for assigned grants and initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

* Bachelor's degree in education, youth development, public administration, nonprofit management, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Five or more years of progressively responsible leadership experience in youth development, education, the nonprofit sector, or workforce development.
* Demonstrated commitment to equity, inclusion, cultural responsiveness, and leadership centered in community.
* Demonstrated success in building and sustaining partnerships across sectors.
* Experience directing or overseeing professional learning for adults, including establishing strategy, guiding staff or contracted trainers, and ensuring quality, within an expanded learning, education, or workforce setting.
* Experience with quality improvement and continuous improvement practices in afterschool and summer programs, education, or a related field.
* Experience providing or overseeing coaching, technical assistance, or organizational development support.
* Experience working with state agencies, initiatives funded by grants, or statewide networks.
* Strong project management, communication, organizational, and data analysis skills.

Preferred

* Master's degree in education, youth development, public administration, nonprofit management, or a related field.
* Knowledge of Oregon's expanded learning infrastructure, including the Oregon Registry (ORO), Core Knowledge Categories (CKCs), and the Oregon Quality Standards for Afterschool and Summer Programs.
* Established relationships with Oregon state agencies, Tribal Nations, education partners, or program providers.
* Demonstrated experience in grant writing, fundraising, or resource development.
* Experience working with Tribal communities, rural communities, or culturally specific organizations.
* Bilingual or bicultural skills, particularly in Spanish and English.

Candidates who meet many, though not all, of the preferred qualifications are encouraged to apply.

Applicants from outside Oregon who bring substantial experience in expanded learning and quality improvement are welcome to apply, as knowledge of the systems particular to Oregon can be developed within the position.

Core Skills

Strategic leadership and systems thinking; the design and oversight of adult learning; facilitation of groups and of convenings across sectors; project and budget management; data analysis, evaluation, and the communication of findings; partnership development and fundraising; public speaking; and strong written and verbal communication.

Compensation and Benefits

Salary range: $80,000\-$90,000 annually, commensurate with experience.

OregonASK offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, paid time off, paid holidays, retirement contribution, and professional development support.

Location, Working Conditions, and Travel

This position is based in Oregon, where OregonASK maintains an office in Portland. Candidates must reside in Oregon, or relocate prior to their start date, in order to sustain the relationships on which this position depends, many of which require presence in the community. The position operates within a hybrid work environment and involves regular travel throughout Oregon, including rural and coastal communities, as well as occasional national travel. Evening and weekend work is required periodically for conferences, trainings, and meetings. A reliable means of statewide travel is required.

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Wilsonville, OR 97070

title: Managing Director, M&A Origination (Sell-Side)
description:
Cebron Global advises founders and owners of lower middle market companies on the sale of their businesses. Our clients are closely held, typically in the $2M to $15M EBITDA range, and the owner is making a once in a lifetime decision.

Our approach pairs proprietary buyer data, direct market outreach, and senior attention on every mandate to connect sellers with the right acquirer, whether strategic, financial, or international. Bankers here carry a limited portfolio by design. We would rather close a smaller number of transactions well than run volume.

We promote from within and are looking for professionals who want to build a practice, not fill a seat.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Managing Director to originate sell\-side M\&A mandates in an assigned territory. You will be the firm in front of the owner.

This is a senior origination seat. You will meet directly with business owners and their trusted advisers, including CPAs, transaction attorneys, and wealth managers. You will develop the relationship, understand the personal and financial objectives behind a potential exit, form an early view on marketability, and convert qualified interest into signed engagements.

Origination is supported by firm marketing, proprietary buyer data, and centralized deal screening. It is not fed by an appointment setting desk. The people who succeed here bring judgment and a network, and they build the rest.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain owner\-level and adviser\-level relationships across an assigned territory
* Conduct industry research and preliminary financial assessment to evaluate the marketability and transaction potential of a prospective client
* Present the firm's sell\-side M\&A services through tailored proposals and owner\-level presentations
* Negotiate engagement terms and fees within firm standards
* Submit prospective transactions through the firm's deal screening process before engagement
* Work with internal teams to assemble complete engagement packages
* Meet or exceed mandate origination targets
* Maintain complete records of outreach, prospecting activity, and pipeline in Salesforce
* Coordinate with transaction professionals, analysts, and marketing to maintain continuity from signature through closing

**Requirements**

* 10\+ years in M\&A origination, investment banking coverage, transaction advisory, or senior B2B consultative business development in professional services
* Demonstrated record of identifying, pursuing, and converting new business independently
* Proven ability to build trust with owners, C\-level executives, and professional advisers
* Broad understanding of business operations across industries, with the ability to form a defensible early view on enterprise value and saleability
* Comfort operating in a metrics driven environment with a limited portfolio and long sales cycles
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
* Proficiency with Salesforce and Microsoft Office 365
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field. MBA or CFA preferred
* Willingness and ability to travel 50 to 75 percent within an assigned territory
* Ability to satisfy all firm and applicable state requirements associated with the role

Preferred: existing adviser referral network in the assigned territory, and prior experience in one or more of the sectors below.

**Industries We Represent**

Industrials and industrial services. Healthcare services and medical products. Technology and tech\-enabled services. Business products and services. Specialty distribution. Transportation and logistics. Construction and engineering services.

**Compensation**

Base salary plus performance compensation. Total expected earnings of $200,000 to $425,000 per year, with performance compensation paid on fees collected by the firm. Compensation is discussed in detail during the interview process.

**Benefits**

Paid time off, standard holidays, and community service days. Eligibility for company subsidized medical, dental, vision, and AD\&D coverage. 401(k) with company match.
